| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/4669?t=6&akid=1064%2E878179%2Ea4HRn9) In my first election, my opponent said I couldn’t win because I was a mom.

So I went door-to-door with my twin boys, and I won. By 30 points. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/4669?t=7&akid=1064%2E878179%2Ea4HRn9) _My husband Curt and I with our twin boys_ I went on to win statewide twice and became the first African American woman to serve as chief justice of North Carolina’s Supreme Court.

Now, I’m taking on my toughest race yet: North Carolina’s open U.S. Senate seat.

Some have said that running to become the third African American woman ever to serve in the U.S. Senate — and the first African American senator from North Carolina — will be difficult to do.

But I’m no stranger to tough fights, and I don’t back down from a challenge.

[If you’re ready to flip North Carolina and hold the Senate, can you split a $5 donation between our campaign and VPP before our FEC deadline? There’s no doubt that we can win if we all work together and do our part.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/4670?t=8&akid=1064%2E878179%2Ea4HRn9) | [RUSH $5 NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/4670?t=9&akid=1064%2E878179%2Ea4HRn9)
---
We’ve seen the same playbook and same type of candidates time and time again in North Carolina. It’s time for us to try something new.

The obstacles are real. History shows that there’s a consistent trend of underfunding for women and people of color who run for office.

But like my mother told me - with hard work and faith, we can do anything. Running for Senate required a big leap of faith — faith in myself and faith that enough good people like you would step up to support us.

No candidate can win a race like this on their own, so my hope is you’re up to answer the call at this important moment for our campaign.

[If you can afford it, please make a $5 donation to our campaign and VPP before our official FEC deadline. Every donation matters because each one sends a message that you believe that we can win North Carolina, hold the Senate, and win real change for the people of this country.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/4670?t=10&akid=1064%2E878179%2Ea4HRn9)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

I’m grateful to everyone that’s taken this leap of faith with us. I believe we will accomplish incredible things together, and when we all do our part, we will win.

\- Cheri Beasley

body:
In a couple of weeks the candidates for governor will report what they
were able to raise at the end of this year.

Everyone who is interested in this race — from our own supporters, to
members of the press who are covering this election, to future volunteers
and voters — will be looking to see how we did.

With your help, we can make sure that when the campaign finance reports
come out next month Texans will see that we have the early support and
resources to win. If enough people pitch in, we can defy the conventional
wisdom about what a candidate who doesn’t take corporate donations can
raise and excite the folks who might still be sitting on the sidelines.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51184?refcode=ema20211229-169167&t=1001&akid=169167%2E444211%2Eu2QrJo ]So if you can, please chip in whatever you can afford today to help our
campaign have a strong showing next month when our campaign finance
reports are released.

Remember, Greg Abbott has tens of millions in the bank already.

From his last finance report we know that he’s been taking $1 million
checks from his biggest donors. We can only imagine what he’s raised since
then.

Let’s make sure that the power of people — more than 80,000 individual
contributors, like you, so far in this campaign — is more powerful than
the special interests, corporate PACs and billionaire donors that are
driving Abbott’s campaign.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51184?refcode=ema20211229-169167&t=1002&akid=169167%2E444211%2Eu2QrJo ]Making a contribution of $3 or whatever you can afford

Thank you for considering this request and helping us to finish the year
strong.

Happy New Year!

Beto

clean_body: Democrats know they must re-elect my opponent, the nation’s most vulnerable Democrat, to keep complete control of the federal government. Democrats know they must re-elect my opponent, the nation's most vulnerable Democrat, to keep complete control of the federal government. | Fellow American, Our campaign is THE top target of the national Democrats. They're nervous because they must re-elect my opponent - who calls himself the most vulnerable incumbent Senate Democrat - in order to keep complete control of the federal government. And they will be watching Team Herschel's fourth quarter numbers closely. At the end of this month, we will close the books on fundraising for 2021. A few days later, our treasurer will report our fundraising totals to the Federal Election Commission (FEC) for the first full quarter I have been in this race. The Democrats and their powerful liberal special interests will scour our report page-by-page, looking for any signs of weakness they can find. Fellow American, our goal is to show a massive groundswell of grassroots support from every county in the Peach State and every state in the nation. Our Democrat opponent has shattered early fundraising records and now has more than $17 million in his re-election war chest. Most of that money comes from blue states around the country, from the same folks who think our country is made stronger by pitting us against each other. Georgia's Senate race will almost certainly decide who controls the Senate Majority and the direction of our nation. At stake are issues that affect every single one of us: who controls our schools, how much we pay to fill up our gas tank, the rising cost of groceries, and the ability for small businesses to find the workers they need to keep their doors open. The Democrats have already begun to take shots at me, and their attacks are going to get much worse. But you know what? I can take them. Nothing I've accomplished in life has been easy and winning this U.S. Senate seat might be my toughest challenge yet. But we're up to the challenge because we have great friends and supporters like you standing with us every step of the way. Thanks for believing in me and standing by my side. Sincerely, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go, but ._

name: David Horowitz
subject: America is on the brink of destruction, Peter
body:
America is on the brink of destruction. I don't say this to shock you or scare you --_I say it because it 's true._ And I say it with confidence because when I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. **My name is David Horowitz, and 50 years ago I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end.** I was side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited Ramparts - the largest magazine of the radical Left. I marched, I wrote manifestos, and I attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam, and my eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan and never looked back. I created the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left, and dedicated my life to exposing them. I did it because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing, I knew what was at stake, and I knew that if I didn't tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. **[Today, I'm asking you to join me in this fight, and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $45 or more to my Freedom Center.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59130656:JIv1OCEvN:m:1:3298722022:518EBB550946B1C743BC491AB1F928DB:r)** _What we 're seeing today didn't happen overnight. It's no coincidence. It's no stroke of luck._ **It 's the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making.** For decades now, the Freedom Center has been in the trenches, exposing this sinister movement and warning of what was to come. America's domestic enemies have smeared us every step of the way, and worked around the clock to cut off both political and financial support to silence us for good. We've been targeted by MasterCard, DiscoverCard, the Southern Poverty Law Center, and so many more because we're willing to say and do what no one else would to expose the enemy within. That's why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain what is happening in this battle now - how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party... ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of the country... ...how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state, and to cancel, de-platform, and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as "white supremacists" and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59130656:JIv1OCEvN:m:1:3298722022:518EBB550946B1C743BC491AB1F928DB:r) **" A Great Book" - Dinesh D'Souza** **" The Enemy Within is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life." - Mark Levin** **" David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation." Laura Ingraham** I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because I knew that if America stood a chance, Americans had to understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because I was the enemy within -- and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because we've reached the point in our history that will decide our future -- and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[So if you donate $45 or more to the Freedom Center today](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59130656:JIv1OCEvN:m:1:3298722022:518EBB550946B1C743BC491AB1F928DB:r)** and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left's evil agenda to every American patriot, I will send you a complimentary copy _The Enemy Within._ The Left is at war with America. They don't simply disagree with us about how to make it better -- they want to destroy it and make way for their Marxist dystopia. **And they don 't care how much they have to lie, cheat, or steal to achieve it.** So it's up to patriots like you and me to show our fellow Americans who they really are and what they really want while we still can. Sincerely, David Horowitz P.S. I know how we got to this point in our country, and I know how we get out. But the clock is ticking, and our country is hanging by a thread. **[Please make a generous donation of $45 or more to the Freedom Center today](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59130656:JIv1OCEvN:m:1:3298722022:518EBB550946B1C743BC491AB1F928DB:r)** , and as a thank you for your generous support, I'll reserve a complimentary copy of my latest book _The Enemy Within_ for you, explaining this in depth. [**Get Your Exclusive Copy of _The Enemy Within_**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59130656:JIv1OCEvN:m:1:3298722022:518EBB550946B1C743BC491AB1F928DB:r) | |

| | Dear Fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...

| | Dear Fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

---|---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zn0m255lun2m466087qqvqqtgltcjl1uneaujji0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0c3jm8o31cph2bs)
---
| | That’s why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zpi44som0eqpvt6eamoknpbul7gcocpe102i6lr0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0c3jm8o31cph2bs)
Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| | |

| Since our launch in February, Greater Georgia has hit the ground running, doing the necessary work to register more voters, engage diverse communities, and protect election integrity. Our team, including countless grassroots volunteers, has knocked doors, written postcards, made calls, sent text messages, and met with conservatives at events statewide, and more.
Just this year, Greater Georgia has made:

* 1.6 MILLION contacts with unregistered, disengaged, and disenfranchised Georgians, and thousands more with registered grassroots volunteers and active voters
* Over 100,000 engagements with unregistered and disengaged Georgians
* Doors program reached over 20,000 households on their doorstep

Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

# Press release from the Erik Aadland Campaign
---
| (Dec. 27, 2021) With great enthusiasm for the future of Colorado, the Aadland for Colorado campaign announces Erik Aadland will transition from the U.S. Senate race to run in Congressional District 7. The decision was made following an abundance of consideration and the garnering of wise counsel.
Erik Aadland, who has been a leading candidate in the U.S. Senate Republican primary, believes the future of the state is at stake. The move to the Congressional race gives Republicans the best advantage in stopping the tide of socialism flooding Colorado.
"When I began my journey to serve as an elected official, I did it to honor the oath I took when I served in the military," said Erik. "I learned firsthand on the battlefields of Iraq and Afghanistan that sacrifice is required to win any fight. We are in a fight for our nation's future. In one direction lies the Progressive Socialist future, led by the likes of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi and Representative Ed Perlmutter; it is the wrong path for our country."
Erik said that in 12 short months we have seen how destructive the Democratic agenda is to the American way of life, and how it has made it more difficult for Coloradans to thrive.
"We must change the direction, and 2022 is not a moment too soon," Erik continued. "Fortunately, in the other direction is the Shining City on a Hill, of which Reagan spoke and our founders envisioned, putting individual rights and Liberty at the forefront. It is the path to prosperity, opportunity and freedom."
Erik, who is a resident of Jefferson County in CD7, has been campaigning statewide in his bid to go to Washington as a U.S. Senator. During that time, Colorado underwent redistricting, with CD7 changing its composition drastically, making it far more competitive for a Republican. Now is the opportune time for a Republican candidate to take this seat back.
Now that he has been redistricted into the 7th, Erik has decided to withdraw from the U.S. Senate race to pursue serving in the U.S. House of Representatives by unseating incumbent Democrat Ed Perlmutter.
"Though it was a very difficult decision after investing significant time, money and effort into the U.S. Senate race, I am motivated by duty and a desire to be of service, and after much prayer and reflection, this is the clearer path to accomplish that end," Erik said.
Key figures at the state and national level who recognize the clear opportunity to win this district are very supportive of Erik's move.
"I am not running for office to serve my own ends--I'm not a career politician," said Erik. "There is a fight for integrity, accountability, transparency and virtue in the U.S. House of Representatives and this seat represents the primary line of defense against the tide of socialism that we've seen under the Biden Administration and Ed Perlmutter."
Erik recognizes it's time for new leadership in the district and intends to defeat Perlmutter by breathing new life into CD7 with fresh ideas and meaningful solutions. As a husband, and a father to three children Erik believes he is more in touch with the needs of Coloradans than a career politician who has served in Congress for more than 14 years with no substantial accomplishments or meaningful benefit to Colorado.
In making this difficult decision, Erik said that it is more important to put the good of the country before any personal ambition.

Now is the opportune time for a Republican candidate to take this seat back. Now that he has been redistricted into the 7th, Erik has decided to withdraw from the U.S. Senate race to pursue serving in the U.S. House of Representatives by unseating incumbent Democrat Ed Perlmutter. "Though it was a very difficult decision after investing significant time, money and effort into the U.S. Senate race, I am motivated by duty and a desire to be of service, and after much prayer and reflection, this is the clearer path to accomplish that end," Erik said. Key figures at the state and national level who recognize the clear opportunity to win this district are very supportive of Erik's move. "I am not running for office to serve my own ends--I'm not a career politician," said Erik. "There is a fight for integrity, accountability, transparency and virtue in the U.S. House of Representatives and this seat represents the primary line of defense against the tide of socialism that we've seen under the Biden Administration and Ed Perlmutter." Erik recognizes it's time for new leadership in the district and intends to defeat Perlmutter by breathing new life into CD7 with fresh ideas and meaningful solutions. As a husband, and a father to three children Erik believes he is more in touch with the needs of Coloradans than a career politician who has served in Congress for more than 14 years with no substantial accomplishments or meaningful benefit to Colorado. body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=gUVIOCb087SpukXJrv66sawozBGgl%2FrK&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend: I need to explain what's riding on our 11:59 p.m. fundraising deadline tomorrow. Not only is it the final and most important public FEC reporting deadline of the year - it's also our last opportunity to ensure we enter the election year with strength in resources. **This is essential to preventing a GOP takeover of Senate control.**
Allow me to outline what's happened under Democratic majorities with investigative power. I've had a front-row seat to it: revelation after revelation of former President Donald Trump's anti-democratic obstruction - aided by cronies from Steve Bannon to Mark Meadows and even Republican members of Congress. Trump's acting attorney general _confirmed_ to our Senate Judiciary Committee that the former President tried to exert executive power and pressure to try to overturn the 2020 election.
Just recently, we even learned that Trump's allies were considering a coup to keep him in power. We also know that the Trump family and GOP members of Congress may have aided or been in contact with violent insurrectionists on the day of the Jan. 6 attack on our capitol.
Those details chill me to the bone every time I recount them - but here's what we must remember: We are only uncovering the full truth because _Democrats_ hold control of Congress. Our majority ensures we are able to investigate and even hold the most powerful people accountable for wrongdoing.
**But if we make missteps on fundraising or strategy and lose our Democratic Senate control, Republicans call the shots again - and you and I both know, Friend, that they will sweep all wrongdoing by Donald Trump under the rug and embolden the streaks of authoritarianism that have infested their party.**
Passing bold legislation, securing justice and accountability, protecting our democracy, and improving the lives of everyday people - it all hinges on protecting and expanding a very fragile Democratic control of the Senate. That's why this deadline is so important, and right now, as I'm facing a $5,219 shortfall, I must ask for your help: [Please, will you rush a contribution of $5 or more - whatever you can spare to ensure we have the resources to defend this must-win Senate seat - so we can fight GOP attacks and protect Democratic Senate control?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1117-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)
Thank you,
Dick

I've had a front-row seat to it: revelation after revelation of former President Donald Trump's anti-democratic obstruction - aided by cronies from Steve Bannon to Mark Meadows and even Republican members of Congress. Trump's acting attorney general confirmed to our Senate Judiciary Committee that the former President tried to exert executive power and pressure to try to overturn the 2020 election. Just recently, we even learned that Trump's allies were considering a coup to keep him in power. We also know that the Trump family and GOP members of Congress may have aided or been in contact with violent insurrectionists on the day of the Jan. 6 attack on our capitol. Those details chill me to the bone every time I recount them - but here's what we must remember: We are only uncovering the full truth because Democrats hold control of Congress. Our majority ensures we are able to investigate and even hold the most powerful people accountable for wrongdoing. But if we make missteps on fundraising or strategy and lose our Democratic Senate control, Republicans call the shots again - and you and I both know, Friend, that they will sweep all wrongdoing by Donald Trump under the rug and embolden the streaks of authoritarianism that have infested their party. Passing bold legislation, securing justice and accountability, protecting our democracy, and improving the lives of everyday people - it all hinges on protecting and expanding a very fragile Democratic control of the Senate. That's why this deadline is so important, and right now, as I'm facing a $5,219 shortfall, I must ask for your help: Thank you, Dick

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Blessed
body:
Dear Peter,

This was
the first year for my organization, the American Cornerstone
Institute. In a few short months, we launched an elementary
school curriculum that supports our nation's founding principles,
defended the unborn, and brought leaders together to find
solutions to our nation's problems.
I feel
blessed because I know that the success of what we accomplished
in 2021 had little to do with me. It had a lot to do with you.

By giving
your time, prayers, and financial gifts, you made everything
possible. The truth is, the American Cornerstone Institute is
nothing without people like you.

I am so
grateful that you have chosen to take this leap of faith with us.
We are already seeing what can be done when everyone has a common
purpose.

While I
could not be more proud of all that was accomplished, I know that
next year will be a challenging one. The current administration
wants to increase dependence on the government at the expense of
personal freedoms.

We've
already seen attacks on our faith and government-imposed
restrictions on gathering together as one body of Christ. We also
saw communities be torn apart because of opposing views.

This is
not the America I want to see, and I know that it is not the
America you want to see. In 2022, we are going to continue our
work to stand for faith, liberty, community and life. But we
can't do that alone. We need your help.

If you
are able, would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to
help us make sure America remains the greatest country on earth?

If you
are able to help, you can do so at this link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/59404104:sNkwSwHNT:m:3:2394957096:581E26C98ED8159AEF4FC65DCCA52932:r

Thank you
so much for everything you have done to make ACI a success in
2021 and making an even bigger success in 2022.

Sincerely,
Dr. Ben
Carson

--
Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder
and Chairman
American
Cornerstone Institute

Friend, Growing up, I learned that through hard work, I could break barriers and achieve anything I set my mind to. [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40186719/323223586/458148127?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20211230_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNTQ1MjE4ZS04OTY5LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q5UlUpE9h1T34ogtjqAorzwm1Er5xW1DpSuvuzDkJUw=) So after becoming a commissioned officer in the U.S. Military, I learned to fly a helicopter and became one of the first handful of women to fly combat missions in Operation Iraqi Freedom. [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40186720/323223587/458148127?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20211230_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNTQ1MjE4ZS04OTY5LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q5UlUpE9h1T34ogtjqAorzwm1Er5xW1DpSuvuzDkJUw=) Then my Blackhawk was shot down over Iraq, costing me both legs and partial use of my right arm. I spent a long, painful year in Walter Reed Hospital undergoing surgeries and intensive physical therapy to relearn how to walk on my new prosthetic legs. [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40186721/323223588/458148127?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20211230_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNTQ1MjE4ZS04OTY5LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q5UlUpE9h1T34ogtjqAorzwm1Er5xW1DpSuvuzDkJUw=) But I’m a fighter, so I turned these experiences into an opportunity to become a champion for Veterans. I ran for Congress and eventually won a seat in the U.S. Senate, where I’m still breaking barriers. In 2018, I became the first sitting Senator to give birth and bring a baby onto the Senate floor so I could care for my child and do my job at the same time. [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40186722/323223589/458148127?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20211230_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNTQ1MjE4ZS04OTY5LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q5UlUpE9h1T34ogtjqAorzwm1Er5xW1DpSuvuzDkJUw=) I’ve overcome so many obstacles and continue to be a fierce advocate for our troops, Veterans and military families in Washington. But Michael and I are both facing tough re-election battles and need your help to stay in the Senate. So please: [_**Can you split a contribution to re-elect Senator Michael Bennet and me so we can continue this important work? We are asking for $5 but any amount you can give will go a long way.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40186723/323223590/458148127?amount=5&refcode=AU_MFB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20211230_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNTQ1MjE4ZS04OTY5LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q5UlUpE9h1T34ogtjqAorzwm1Er5xW1DpSuvuzDkJUw=) Thank you for being on our team. All our best, Tammy |

I rarely have a free moment these days, friend, so I'm grateful to have a few spare minutes to share why I'm investing so much into this Senate race.
I grew up in the segregated South. My parents worked minimum wage jobs, and I washed dishes at fast-food chains to pay my way through college. So when I thought about the leadership this country really needs, I thought about hardworking families like mine. I thought about the opportunities I've been given my entire life and how I could fight to ensure this promise of America exists for _everyone_._ _
So I jumped into this race, and I haven't looked back. And now, with an even split in the Senate and experts saying this race will decide Senate control, it's becoming clear that what this team does together _will determine_ whether I can help strengthen voting rights, safeguard reproductive freedom and pass President Biden's agenda.
I know this political moment isn't easy, but I can't let you give up on this shared future now. I'm just 2 points away from Marco Rubio, and I know I can surge ahead, flip Florida blue and expand this Senate majority if I muster the resources it will take to defeat such a well-funded incumbent.

clean_body: why I'm investing so much into this Senate race | | | I rarely have a free moment these days, friend, so I'm grateful to have a few spare minutes to share why I'm investing so much into this Senate race. I grew up in the segregated South. My parents worked minimum wage jobs, and I washed dishes at fast-food chains to pay my way through college. So when I thought about the leadership this country really needs, I thought about hardworking families like mine. I thought about the opportunities I've been given my entire life and how I could fight to ensure this promise of America exists for everyone. So I jumped into this race, and I haven't looked back. And now, with an even split in the Senate and experts saying this race will decide Senate control, it's becoming clear that what this team does together will determine whether I can help strengthen voting rights, safeguard reproductive freedom and pass President Biden's agenda. I know this political moment isn't easy, but I can't let you give up on this shared future now. I'm just 2 points away from Marco Rubio, and I know I can surge ahead, flip Florida blue and expand this Senate majority if I muster the resources it will take to defeat such a well-funded incumbent. I have to run to my next meeting now, but my biggest fundraising deadline of the year is tomorrow at midnight, and I still need 8,667 Democrats to become a member of this grassroots team, including you. = Before I head out, I have to ask: = Thank you so much for your dedication to this campaign. Val Demings | | = Val Demings here: I can’t thank you enough for fighting alongside me to flip Florida blue. Florida will determine whether Democrats keep our Senate majority – that’s why Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race to crush our movement and keep Florida red permanently. Our grassroots campaign is off to a great start, but in a race as close as this one, I need your help to surge ahead and defend the Senate. I’m relying on grassroots supporters like you, donating to emails like this, to help me defeat Marco Rubio and stop Mitch McConnell from flipping the Senate. Will you donate today to help me flip Florida blue? = If you’d like to purchase merchandise to show your support for this campaign, Thank you for your continued support. Together we’re going to protect voting rights, expand access to affordable health care and fully recover from this pandemic.

Hey Team New Deal — I hope you’re enjoying the holiday season!

I’ve been reflecting on everything we’ve accomplished this year — and I couldn’t be prouder to have you in this fight alongside me advocating for a brighter, more inclusive, more equitable Texas.

We have transformed our small, scrappy team into a solid grassroots coalition of supporters across the district and beyond. We have built this thing together — _**brick by brick, dollar by dollar, person by person.**_

Unlike typical campaigns, our movement is completely powered by everyday working people like you. People who are tired of a government that only works for some. People who deserve to have their voices heard. People who want to see meaningful changes reflected in our communities.

Without taking a cent of corporate PAC money or special interest handouts, Team New Deal has proven that we can be successful without sacrificing our values or compromising on our demands for progressive change.

# [U.S. Commits $1 Mil to End Racism, Ethnic Prejudice in South America Focusing on “Afro-Latinas”](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57502&L=26479&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdS1zLWNvbW1pdHMtMS1taWwtdG8tZW5kLXJhY2lzbS1ldGhuaWMtcHJlanVkaWNlLWluLXNvdXRoLWFtZXJpY2EtZm9jdXNpbmctb24tYWZyby1sYXRpbmFzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNvcnJ1cHRpb24rY2hyb25pY2xlcyZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz)
As part of its foreign policy on “advancing racial equity and support of underserved communities,” the Biden administration is spending a million dollars to eliminate racial and ethnic discrimination, inequality, and systemic racism in South America. Besides bolstering racial justice in the foreign nations, the U.S. taxpayer dollars will encourage civil society organizations to promote and protect the human rights of communities marginalized by “intersectional discrimination,” according to the grant announcement posted by the government this month. The administration identifies intersectional discrimination as “multiple and overlapping social identities, including communities experiencing disproportionate injustices such as Afro-Latinas and African Descendant members of LGBTI+ communities.”
[Read More](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57502&L=26479&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdS1zLWNvbW1pdHMtMS1taWwtdG8tZW5kLXJhY2lzbS1ldGhuaWMtcHJlanVkaWNlLWluLXNvdXRoLWFtZXJpY2EtZm9jdXNpbmctb24tYWZyby1sYXRpbmFzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNvcnJ1cHRpb24rY2hyb25pY2xlcyZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz)

### [Fight to clean voter lists gains ground after 2020 election ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57502&L=26537&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY2xlYW4tdm90ZXItbGlzdHMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Y29ycnVwdGlvbitjaHJvbmljbGVzJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=) The Washington Times Tom Fitton, president of Judicial Watch, another group that polices voter rolls, said the key moment for election integrity came a few years back, when the Supreme Court reaffirmed the requirement in federal law that states do have to take steps to clean up their lists. | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40191271/323243649/-2081290588?refcode=jtk1138-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzc2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTNkOTdhMS05MjY5LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9KDjusQqO1QQ4hhsgiEjFY8WQZx2GHZ8qDmruMm3_B4=&emci=d2c84659-3660-ec11-94f6-0050f2e65e9b&emdi=253d97a1-9269-ec11-94f6-0003ffc5857e&ceid=24265352)

Peter,

As this year comes to a close, I can't help but think about our resilience and the challenges we've overcome by working together.
When the clock struck midnight on Jan. 1, 2021, so many of us were feeling isolated, experiencing anxiety about contracting the virus, or mourning family members who had passed. My heart goes out to each and every New Mexican who felt the agony of losing a loved one in the past year.
**Little by little, we're moving past those dark times.** New Mexico ran one of the most successful vaccination programs in the country – which allowed grandparents to safely hug their children without fear and friends to safely reunite after so many months apart. As we continue to address the pandemic, I'm so hopeful that we'll return to normalcy soon.
**Despite the challenges we've faced, I'm proud to say that we've also made huge steps forward on our bold agenda in the past year.** We strengthened education by improving equity in schools. We officially made cannabis legal. And we put money back into the pockets of struggling families by making progressive changes to our tax code.
**Today, the future looks brighter than it did one year ago.** As we enter my reelection year, I know that there's so much more in store for the Land of Enchantment. I have plans to invest in our educators, continue to act on the climate crisis, rebuild our infrastructure, and so much more.
**All of this work is possible because of grassroots supporters like you** , who stand up to advocate for the policies New Mexicans need to thrive. Thank you so much for your work this year.
I wish you and yours a very happy new year!

All the best,

Michelle Lujan Grisham

Hi Peter,

I'm writing to you from my home in Cedar Rapids. I hope you had a wonderful holiday season and are gearing up for a great New Year's Eve tomorrow. I'm reaching out to you personally today to ask that you make your very first contribution by donating $5. I promise it will make a meaningful impact in our race to defeat Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA). I hope you'll allow me a moment to explain.
Right now, polling from the Des Moines Register shows Sen. Grassley has a record-high disapproval rating with Iowa voters. He's vulnerable, and Republicans know that he's on thin ice. It's probably why the Senate Republican campaign arm has been actively attacking me, and they have nearly $30 million in the bank to go on attacking me and protecting their Trump-endorsed incumbent. I want you to hear this from me: I have every intention of winning this race, but I cannot do it without an unprecedented movement made up of people like you donating $5, $10 or $20 at a time. Your hard-earned dollars build up this movement.
Nearly $30 million in Republican money is a lot to compete with. The full backing of Mitch McConnell and Donald Trump is a lot to compete with. But we _can_ compete and win if we build up the strongest grassroots movement possible! That's why, ahead of our last public FEC reporting deadline of the year, it's so important that you make your first contribution of $5 or whatever you can spare to defeat Sen. Grassley. The best link to donate is right here: **[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/abby-finkenauer-email](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40191735/323245343/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk474-fr-nd-v2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDRmMzk1Mi05MzY5LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0EZs3eDVwgVp81yPWJ_WgiRutReqJhxTZ0yLAmsOnDQ=)**
I am not someone who backs down from a challenge, and I've gone up against people like Sen. Grassley before: I won an election against a man double my age, flipped a House seat blue and became the youngest woman to pass legislation through the House. Still, as a young woman in public service, I can't count the number of times I've been underestimated or counted out.
The pundits and so-called experts will say what they want to say, but at the end of the day, I know that with lots of hard work and unwavering grassroots support, we will flip this Senate seat blue.
This is personal. Right now, working families in communities across Iowa are being failed by a senator who has left them behind. Those families are _my_ family. Dad was a union pipefitter-welder, and Mom worked for the Dubuque public school system. They inspired me to show up for my community, which is exactly why I'm running to defeat Sen. Grassley. It's time to lift up the voices of Iowa's working families in the Senate.
Peter, I appreciate you sticking with me as I write about what this race means to me. I'm going to bring this email to a close. But before I do, I've got to press the importance of building up a grassroots movement again. When you chip in $5, along with hundreds of other people, it adds up to something powerful. It adds up to a campaign that can compete and win. So please, will you make your first donation to help me win in Iowa and defeat Sen. Grassley? Abby

**Team Tom End of Year Update | Thursday, December 30th, 2021**
Peter,
We launched our campaign for Governor of Maryland just over six months ago, and since then, we’ve had so much fun visiting all 23 Maryland counties and Baltimore City! From biking through Western Maryland, to touring main streets on the Eastern Shore, to meeting folks down in Southern Maryland and everywhere in between, Tom has visited every corner of our state. Along the way, he’s had the chance to share his vision of jobs and justice, as well as his plan to build a future where every Marylander has the opportunity to succeed.
As we head into the New Year, we wanted to share some highlights from the past six months with our strongest supporters. We are grateful for your support, your commitment, your time, and your friendship. Team Tom wouldn’t be what it is without you. Together, we can build a brighter future for all Marylanders.
All the best,
Jessica Semachko
Campaign Manager
Tom Perez for Maryland

**On the Campaign Trail**

clean_body: Thank you for your generous support of Tom's campaign! Keep reading for a recap of his time on the campaign trail, an update on upcoming events, and ways to get involved. = Team Tom End of Year Update | Thursday, December 30th, 2021 Peter, We launched our campaign for Governor of Maryland just over six months ago, and since then, we’ve had so much fun visiting all 23 Maryland counties and Baltimore City! From biking through Western Maryland, to touring main streets on the Eastern Shore, to meeting folks down in Southern Maryland and everywhere in between, Tom has visited every corner of our state. Along the way, he’s had the chance to share his vision of jobs and justice, as well as his plan to build a future where every Marylander has the opportunity to succeed. As we head into the New Year, we wanted to share some highlights from the past six months with our strongest supporters. We are grateful for your support, your commitment, your time, and your friendship. Team Tom wouldn’t be what it is without you. Together, we can build a brighter future for all Marylanders. All the best, Jessica Semachko Campaign Manager Tom Perez for Maryland On the Campaign Trail On June 23rd, Tom officially launched his campaign for Governor of Maryland in Montgomery County and Baltimore. It was an exciting day, and supporters stood with Tom as he shared his vision for creating a state where zip code never determines destiny. Former Montgomery County Executive Ike Leggett, Senator Cory McCray, and Charles County Commissioner President Reuben Collins all endorsed Tom and shared why we need him in Annapolis next year. You can watch Tom’s launch video . Tom understands how important it is for all Marylanders to have a voice; that’s why he has been visiting every corner of our state, meeting Marylanders and listening to what they need in their next Governor. From touring downtown Salisbury with City Administrator Julia Glans, visiting with small business owners, attending the Annual Millard Tawes Crab and Clam Bake, hosting meet and greets across the shore, and meeting with folks who have served on the frontlines of the pandemic, Tom has spent many busy days on Maryland’s eastern shore. Tom has also made quite a few stops to Western Maryland including touring downtown Hagerstown with Visit Hagerstown President Dan Spedden, and meeting with Marylanders from Allegany County, Washington County, and all the way to Frederick. Tom was able to experience Oakland’s Annual Autumn Glory festival while biking throughout Garrett County! Tom has also spent time in Southern Maryland meeting with local leaders and advocates and visiting some of the local businesses. Tom even had an opportunity to host a meet and greet at one of his new favorite spots, Patuxent Brewing Company in Charles County, one of the only Black-owned breweries in the state. Baltimore deserves a Governor that will be a true partner. Tom has been able to take different tours of various neighborhoods throughout Baltimore City with key leaders including Senator Cory McCray, Delegate Luke Clippinger, Delegate Robbyn Lewis, Councilwoman Danielle McCray, and Councilman Ryan Dorsey. Just last week, we announced that 14 elected and community leaders from the Baltimore region have endorsed Tom Perez for Governor of Maryland! You can watch the announcement video . From 4th of July, to Labor Day Weekend, to Thanksgiving, Tom has participated in parades across the state with #TeamTom supporters marching alongside him. Tom has had the opportunity to share his vision for our great state at more than 10 different gubernatorial forums hosted by groups such as the Montgomery County Renter’s Alliance, Maryland Family Network, the Latino Caucus, the Legislative Black Caucus of Maryland, the Maryland Democratic Party, the Committee for Montgomery, and more. Marylanders deserve a Governor who understands that when unions thrive, we all thrive. Tom has had the privilege of visiting union facilities, attending events, speaking at conventions, and getting to know union members who work hard each and every day. Tom has dedicated his career to fighting for working people, and he could not have been more proud to have rolled out endorsements of over 100 total labor unions so far in our campaign. Our unions, workers, and organizers built our middle class, and we must all join their fight for justice. Tom spent time with Senator Joanne Benson and volunteers in Prince George’s County packaging and distributing Thanksgiving meals at St Margaret's Church in Capitol Heights. He was blessed to have the opportunity to connect with folks from Prince George’s County. Tom joined Latino community leaders from across the state for a meet and greet at the home of Montgomery County Council President Gabe Albornoz. As the son of immigrants from the Dominican Republic, Tom knows the value of standing up for working families and immigrants by fighting for issues like affordable housing, immigration programs, and supporting the growth and success of minority owned businesses throughout the state. Tom turned 60! He celebrated with friends, family, and supporters at a grassroots fundraiser in his home of Takoma Park. We have built a strong grassroots movement across our state, and we are so blessed for the supporters who have made the energy at our fundraisers and meet and greets incredible. #TeamTom supporters have been coming out in force every Saturday to knock on doors and share the message of Tom Perez for Governor! Tom is incredibly blessed to have met with Marylanders in every corner of our state. Each region of our state is unique, and Tom is committed to being a Governor that represents us all. We are looking forward to continuing to meet with Marylanders from all over in the months to come! Endorsements Tom is running a campaign by, and for, Marylanders. We are proud of the strong coalition of support he is building throughout the state. He’s earned the support of individuals and organizations that represent hundreds of thousands of people across Maryland and the United States. Team, Rachel Maddow is sounding the alarm.
2022 is going to be a tough year for Democrats, but especially Maggie Hassan – New Hampshire is the GOP’s number one target. Maggie is the most vulnerable incumbent Democrat in the Senate, and **our race could be the tipping point for our Democratic Senate majority.**

We’re looking for a huge number of grassroots donations to sustain our campaign in the months to come. If you’ve already donated to our campaign, we’d like to give our warmest thanks for your support. If you haven’t, you still have time to chip in!

Team Franchot

I was the first candidate to release both a detailed platform outlining my vision for the future of Maryland, and another platform dedicated to leveling the playing field for Black Marylanders. And every week on the campaign trail, our activists, allies, and supporters continue to grow our people-powered movement from the grassroots up.

Peter, before I was elected to Congress, I was a teacher -- _for over 20 years._

My grandfather was an American immigrant.

And in the 1940s, my family had to start over with nothing when they were wrongfully interned in Japanese-American internment camps.

**All this is to say that I’m not a typical politician. I ran for Congress because I wanted to make a real difference in working class, marginalized communities.**

And as a result, my campaign isn’t funded by corporate special interests and wealthy donors.

**It’s funded by everyday people like you.**

I can still hear her saying those words.
They've been the driving force behind my fight for better healthcare, good jobs, higher wages, and safer communities as a Pennsylvania State Representative.
And they’re what’s driving me to take this fight to the United States Senate.
This campaign belongs to working people — because it’s time we have someone who knows the struggles we face fighting our battles in Washington.
I’m running to get things done for Pennsylvania's working families, and I’ll never back down when it comes to making sure folks can get a fair shot.

body:
Friend,
On the very first day of his presidency, Joe Biden signed an executive
order killing nearly 11,000 jobs and terminated our Keystone XL Pipeline, which
transported oil our country and the world so desperately relied upon.

That same week, Joe Biden also terminated public land lease sales, resulting
in a potential loss of up to 300,000 additional jobs, which further harmed our
energy industry.

Nearly 365 days later, Joe Biden and his radical allies in Congress have
taken even more actions to harm oil and gas companies, while relying on foreign
oil to fill our newly created energy shortage caused by our newly elected
President.

These misguided policies have now further ignited hyperinflation that has
affected all Americans, especially here at home in the Energy Capital of the
World. Crude oil, gasoline, natural gas, propane, and nearly every single other
energy product has risen under President Biden.

December 30th, 2021
## Two Years into Pandemic - U of MN to Study Ivermectin & Other Drugs for COVID Treatment
As we approach the two year mark of the COVID-19 Pandemic, major medical organizations still do not have a standard protocol on how to treat COVID at home. Typical advice from doctors is to monitor and call if conditions worsen. People in higher risk categories, end up in the hospital because they don't get on top of treating the virus in advance. However, some medical professionals have [developed their own protocol](https://www.action4liberty.com/university_of_mn_to_study_ivermectin_other_drugs_for_covid_treatment?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mn_is_studying_ivermectin&n=2) which includes repurposed drugs like Ivermectin. Now the University of Minnesota wants to study it. [According to the University of Minnesota](https://www.action4liberty.com/university_of_mn_to_study_ivermectin_other_drugs_for_covid_treatment?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mn_is_studying_ivermectin&n=3), the purpose of the study is to "understand if [Ivermectin, Metformin and Fluvoxamin] prevent severe Covid and long-Covid symptoms." **Why are these drugs being studied now after nearly two years of the Pandemic? The Biden Administration, Governor Walz and the Medical Establishment have pushed a "vaccination only" approach. Utility of drugs like Ivermectin have been known since early in the Pandemic. And, the Wall Street Journal published an article on Tuesday on how studies have shown Fluvoxamine is effective at preventing hospitalizations.** If the study finds these drugs to be effective, politicians like Governor Walz and public health officials need to be held accountable. **Jake Duesenberg** **Action 4 Liberty** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_stop_vaccine_mandates?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mn_is_studying_ivermectin&n=4 "Support Us") [Support Us](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_stop_vaccine_mandates?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mn_is_studying_ivermectin&n=4)

body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/69fd8356c04f/brice-wiggins-for-congress-highlights-from-the-campaign-trail-8710441?e=698f056321)
Logo

Dear Supporters,

Heather and I hope you all had a wonderful Christmas, and we want to wish you a Happy New Year! We are so thankful for your support this past year and for all of the wonderful people we have met.

We would like to say thank you again to those who have already contributed to our campaign. It is heartwarming to know that so many of you believe in our vision for a better future. This Friday, December 31st is an important reporting deadline. Our campaign is experiencing tremendous momentum and has received much support since our announcement! If you haven't yet contributed to our campaign, we humbly ask that you consider a monetary contribution before midnight this Friday. This will help us start 2022 strong as we seek to change the status quo in Washington. To donate, just CLICK HERE (https://bricewiggins.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=094d93d9b142a07f60f23dbdd&id=abd2805195&e=698f056321) or on the button below. Please feel free to forward this email to your friends and family!

subject: Join Speaker Pelosi for her Speaker’s New Year’s Update on Monday, Jan. 3rd at Noon PST!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Pelosi for Congress
body:
Dear Friends:

It is my hope that you are enjoying a safe Holiday Season. It is my prayer that the New Year is a Healthy and Happy one for you and your loved ones.

As we leave 2021, I am writing to thank you for making it a successful legislative year. With your mobilization and support, we were able to enact President Biden's agenda with the American Rescue Plan and the Bipartisan Infrastructure Framework to rebuild our country. With your continued advocacy and support, we are continuing our work to Build Back Better and Protect the Vote.

It had been my wish to invite you to our Traditional Holiday Party in early January, but that must be postponed for now because of COVID. But hopefully not for long. I am writing now to invite you to join me for a special conversation:

Speaker's New Year’s Update
Monday, January 3, 2022
12:00 Noon PST

Joining us will be my House Colleague Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren, Chair of the House Administration Committee and Chair of the California Democratic Congressional Delegation. Our conversation will give us a running start on the New Session of Congress which begins on Monday, January 10th.

You can register here: https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_UUZ1UgQbRwG--BtQNYiREw

Sadly, we are mourning the passing of Majority Leader Harry Reid – a great American Patriot. Right up until the end, he was insisting on how important it is for us to hold the Congress in next year’s election! We could not agree more; our work on the road to a great victory in 2022 starts now!

To that end, I hope you will join us on Monday to Build Back Better and to win together. Thank you for all that you do For The People!

Happy New Year!

Nancy

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.

As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.

We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.

Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

Nancy isn't one to back down from a fight, and we're in this for the long haul. Peter,

Can you believe that in just 48 hours we’ll be on the cusp of celebrating our 2nd anniversary with COVID19 as a daily part of our lives?

I for one am tired of the media and Democrats using the pandemic as a trojan horse for socialism. We’re spending money like drunken sailors. Our individual liberties have been trounced and continue to be under constant threat from authoritarians running the show in D.C. and **President Biden and VP Harris clearly do NOT have a grip on the power they wield.**

I didn’t go to a fancy college to study political science. 2021 YEAR END MEMO

To: Conservative Cavalry
From: Team CAVPAC

When Secretary Pompeo launched CAVPAC back in June, we had no idea how fast we would grow, how committed you would be and how many victories we would celebrate this year.

One thing we have learned is that the American people can see past the noise, the rhetoric and the misinformation coming from Big Tech and the corporate media. They tried to declare the America First movement dead and claimed that Joe Biden was going to solve all our problems. Neither of those things came true.

The truth is Joe Biden’s presidency has resulted in crisis after crisis. Joe Biden and Kamala Harris have been defined by failures, mistakes, self-inflicted wounds and just plain bad policy that you’d be hard-pressed to find a historical parallel to make. We’re experiencing an inflation crisis, a border crisis, a crisis in Afghanistan, a crime crisis, a supply-chain crisis and - worst of all - a leadership crisis.

At the same time, the Democrat-controlled Congress and Democrats in states across America have been pushing a radical agenda that fails to address the real issues facing our country. They’ve pushed to defund the police, open up our borders, give illegal immigrants the right to vote, raise taxes, create more government mandates, push Critical Race Theory in our schools and rig elections in their favor.

**Thankfully, the American people are standing up and saying ENOUGH.**

In Virginia, a state which the media declared would never elect a Republican again, elected an entire Republican ticket, and Republicans will also now control the Virginia House of Delegates. From coast to coast, in races large and small, conservative candidates won sweeping victories as voters rejected the Democrats' agenda.

**And here at CAVPAC, each and every candidate that Secretary Pompeo endorsed WON their elections in November.** Secretary Pompeo takes his endorsements seriously, and he will always support strong conservatives who can win and deliver for the American people.

For an organization that has yet to celebrate our first birthday, these results demonstrate just how much we can accomplish in the year ahead. Our goal was simple — get behind conservative candidates who best fit the Pipehitter mentality that has defined CAVPAC from day one. Our candidates are people who get the job done, no matter how great the odds. They’re unapologetically American, love our country and NEVER apologize for America. They are dedicated to protecting our values, and they never ever give up.

But we have our work cut out for us in 2022. We MUST flip the House and the Senate to Republicans. We are just ONE seat away from flipping the Senate and FIVE seats away from flipping the House. Victory is definitely within reach, but the Democrats aren’t going down without a fight.

In key races across the country, Democrats have raised record sums of money. They have big money donors in their pockets, and they are pulling out all the stops to hang on to power. Get ready for plenty of lies and false attack ads. They will stop at nothing, so we MUST work extra hard to counter their attacks.

That’s why we’ve endorsed strong Republicans with backbones who won’t give an inch to the radical Left. I’m talking about good conservatives like Sarah Huckabee Sanders in Arkansas, Wesley Hunt in Texas, Amanda Adkins in Kansas, Ashley Hinson and Marianette Miller-Meeks in Iowa, among many others! Secretary Pompeo will be making even more endorsements in 2022 because he is going to do everything he can to push Republicans to victory!

We’re not only proud of our candidates.**We’re also proud of YOU.** Week after week, we’ve been reaching out to you through email or text message, and you’ve been responsive. You’ve shared your opinions and made critical donations to help us reach our goals. YOU have been and will always be on the frontline of our success.

But, we cannot stop now. We must all commit to working even harder in 2022 if we are going to be successful.

That’s why we are asking you to **[make a final 2021 donation](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-36kpz-1rcb4-4qqlpo3/ "make a final 2021 donation")** before we close the books on the year. Every single dollar will be key in whether we win or lose in 2022, and we know the Democrats will have the money necessary to run competitive races. We are counting on grassroots conservatives like you to power our movement and ensure our candidates have the support they need to WIN BIG.

**[So, please make a quick contribution to help Secretary Pompeo and our team continue to deliver results. Whether it’s $1,000 or $1, every single donation will be put to good use and will help us accomplish our shared goals.](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-36kpz-1rcb5-4qqlpo4/ "So, please make a quick contribution to help Secretary Pompeo and our team continue to deliver results. Whether it’s $1,000 or $1, every single donation will be put to good use and will help us accomplish our shared goals. ")**

Again, we know the momentum is on our side as we head into 2022. The American people have seen the failures of complete Democrat control, and the America First movement is alive and strong.

Now, we just have to finish the job.

Thank you again for all you have done and continue to do for Secretary Pompeo, CAVPAC and our country. We are honored to have you on the team!

-Team CAVPAC

PS: **[Don’t forget to make a final 2021 donation in the next 24 hours!](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-36kpz-1rcb6-4qqlpo5/ "Don’t forget to make a final 2021 donation in the next 24 hours!")** Every dollar will be key in helping us push Republican candidates to victory up and down the ballot.

name: Rep. Val Demings
subject: I'm coming to you personally, friend
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Val Demings for U
body:
My unlikely story of opportunity is proof of what's possible
| | |
---
Friend: We are coming up on the final, most important fundraising deadline of the year. What we do right now will determine our first public numbers of election year and show the strength of our campaign.

I don't doubt you're getting a lot of emails, **but this email is unlike any other you'll get ahead of such a big fundraising deadline, so I hope you'll give it a read.**
When I'm in the middle of make-or-break moments like this for my Senate race, my mind often goes back to Jacksonville – back to the tiny house I grew up in with six brothers and sisters. Things weren't always easy. Mom was a maid, Dad was a janitor, and although we didn't have a lot of money, we had each other.
In fact, it was Mom who used to say to me: "Never grow tired of doing good, Val — _never_ tire." Those words inspired me to get into public service, and ever since then, growing tired of doing what's right was never an option.
These words have been deep in my soul as I have served the public, from my time in the Orlando Police Department to Congress. They're the words I spoke to myself as I impeached Donald Trump. And they're the words I think about now, as I see how we desperately need more than a 50-50 Senate to build back better for the American people.

_Never tire,_ I think, as I recognize Florida is Democrats' best opportunity to expand our Senate majority. _Never tire_ , I think, as polls show me statistically tied with my opponent, and I come out of yet another finance meeting with the realization I'm far behind where I need to be before a big deadline like this.
My unlikely story of opportunity is proof of what's possible – and I promise I will never tire as I work to make sure the greatness of America is accessible and affordable for _all_ Americans. **A 50-50 Senate isn't working for you or our country, and it's up to us to expand our majority and secure a future for voting rights, reproductive freedom and all our shared values.**
**So as I face down this final FEC deadline of 2021, I need to build a huge grassroots team to help me surge ahead in the new year. That's why I set an ambitious goal to recruit 10,000 members before midnight tonight, and I'm counting on you to join, friend:**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40200816/323284931/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2039-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjk4NzRmNy1hZjY5LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IHuqhT5GON8ZPi4Ys2bAZehA2Zz9rjbcKwWXdZh18jk=)
**[Friend, I ask a lot of you because I have so much faith that you'll never tire _, _either. You know the stakes of this election, so before my most important fundraising deadline of our campaign thus far, can you donate $5 to become a member of this grassroots team? Every donor will help me defeat Marco Rubio and expand our Democratic Senate majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40200817/323284932/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2039-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjk4NzRmNy1hZjY5LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IHuqhT5GON8ZPi4Ys2bAZehA2Zz9rjbcKwWXdZh18jk=)**
Thank you for being in this with me.

Val Demings
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40200818/323284933/1581265324?refcode=jtk2039-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjk4NzRmNy1hZjY5LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IHuqhT5GON8ZPi4Ys2bAZehA2Zz9rjbcKwWXdZh18jk=) **Val Demings here:** I can’t thank you enough for fighting alongside me to flip Florida blue. Florida will determine whether Democrats keep our Senate majority – that’s why Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race to crush our movement _and_ keep Florida red _permanently_. Hello, In just a moment, I’m going to ask you to make a donation to my reelection campaign. I know you’ve gotten a lot of emails, and I’ve asked you this before. But I hope you’ll take a minute to let me explain why your support matters so much, especially right now. As you may know, my 2016 Senate election was one of the closest in history. I won by 1,017 votes and unseated a Republican incumbent in the most expensive Senate race New Hampshire had ever seen. Tomorrow at midnight, we’re closing the books on 2021 – and our final FEC deadline of the year. When our numbers go public, Republicans will comb through every line of our report looking for signs of weakness. And if they sense any vulnerabilities, they won’t hesitate to strike. Mitch McConnell and his allies have spent over $7 million attacking me – more than any other Democrat on the ballot next year. They’re backed by dark money, far-right billionaires, and super PACs with bottomless war chests. If we’re going to stand up to their attacks and win this race, it’s going to take an army of grassroots supporters. My team set a goal of 100,000 grassroots donations before we close the books tomorrow. We can’t match the Republican mega-donors and their million-dollar checks, but we can show the strength of our campaign with people like you chipping in $5 or more whenever you can. **[Please, can you donate $5 today? I first got involved in public service in large part because of my son Ben, who experiences severe disabilities – to help kids like him access the same opportunities as their peers. I ran for office to make a difference for as many people who needed my help as I could and to ensure all Americans have the opportunity to succeed.
I still remember the long night in 2017 when Senate Republicans tried to repeal the Affordable Care Act, and they failed by one vote. I realized that night that if it weren’t for 1,017 votes in New Hampshire, a Republican would have been in my seat – and millions of Americans would have lost their health care coverage.
That’s why I’m so grateful for grassroots supporters like you, my friend. Your support got us those 1,017 votes we needed to flip this seat in 2016. Your enthusiasm helped us flip the Senate and win the White House in 2020. And with you on our team, we are going to take on the tough fight ahead and keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue in 2022.

I ran for office to make a difference for as many people who needed my help as I could and to ensure all Americans have the opportunity to succeed. I still remember the long night in 2017 when Senate Republicans tried to repeal the Affordable Care Act, and they failed by one vote. I realized that night that if it weren’t for 1,017 votes in New Hampshire, a Republican would have been in my seat – and millions of Americans would have lost their health care coverage. That’s why I’m so grateful for grassroots supporters like you, my friend. Your support got us those 1,017 votes we needed to flip this seat in 2016. Your enthusiasm helped us flip the Senate and win the White House in 2020. And with you on our team, we are going to take on the tough fight ahead and keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue in 2022. = Thank you for being with me. With every good wish, Maggie Hassan = | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. #
Peter, can you believe it? Our final fundraising goal of 2021 — the last before a consequential midterm election year — is coming up at midnight tomorrow.
**So we wanted to check in with you to share your 2021 supporter record.** Here's what we have on file for you, Peter:
**2021 Supporter Record for Peter**
**Email:** dpwillis67@gmail.com
**2021 Donor?:** No — not yet!**
****2021 Total:** $0
**Suggested donation:** $3
**[Contribute $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20211230?refcode=em20211230-917&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&refcode2=917_420207_Zkwjtv&akid=917%2E420207%2EZkwjtv)**
_(FYI: If you donated recently, in the mail, or with a different email address, your record might not yet reflect your contribution. Thank you for your support!)_
There's so much at stake. Pramila is still fighting for the transformative Build Back Better Act because working people are counting on Congress to deliver. She's continued her fierce advocacy for Democrats in the Senate to immediately end the filibuster and protect abortion rights by passing the Women's Health Protection Act. And she's never shied away from opposing excessive, bloated military spending that takes even more money away from our communities.
As we turn to 2022 and a critical midterm election cycle, we have big plans to expand our progressive coalition in Congress — plans that require us to make necessary, early investments right now to see them through. **But that means we can't afford to lose our momentum in fundraising — and we need to meet every fundraising goal from here on out,****_especially the last fundraising goal of the year._**

In solidarity,
Lauren

name: Andrew Hughes, American Cornerstone Institute
subject: We don't have much time left
body:
We don't have much time left

Dear
Peter,

I wanted
to reach out to you because tomorrow is the last day you can make
a gift to American Cornerstone Institute before the end of the
year. It is your last opportunity to protect future generations
from the onslaught of policies from the radical left this year.

Tomorrow
is critical.

As Dr.
Carson mentioned, our plan for next year is ambitious.

We
need to get our new elementary curriculum into the hands of
hundreds of thousands of children-we want the next generation to
understand the founding principles that made our country so
great.

We
are going to ramp up the legal battles aimed at protecting our
rights and the rights of the unborn.

We
will bring national leaders together to develop conservative
solutions to our nation's most pressing problems.

We can
only do this with your help.

If you
are able, please consider making a tax-deductible gift to the
American Cornerstone Institute before midnight tomorrow.

You can
make a contribution at this secure link:
https://secure.americancornerstone.org/year-end

We were
able to accomplish a lot in our first year, and we are looking
forward to doing a lot more in 2022.

We could
not have done anything without your support and we are incredibly
grateful for everything you have already done for us. We are very
excited about the future and I hope you will join us.

I truly
hope God blesses you in the new year.

God
Bless,

- Andrew

---
Andrew
Hughes
CEO and
Executive Director
American
Cornerstone Institute

P.S. I
know we've sent you a few emails, but that is only because this
is so important. It is vital we reach our goal to be as effective
as we need to be in 2022. Please consider donating before
midnight tomorrow at this secure link if you are able:
https://secure.americancornerstone.org/year-end

American
Cornerstone Institute

323
Pennsylvania Ave SE

Washington, DC 20003-1148

body:
I can't do this alone. I need your support. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/abelfortexas.com/thank-you-and-happy-holidays-8600213?e=2dc92facb0)

|
