[](https://abelfortexas.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6097af3608cb27432006e1b74&id=a570966e87&e=2dc92facb0)
| | | | | | December 30, 2021

I can’t believe it’s been two months since we started this journey together. These past 60 days, connecting and listening to voters across the district, have only reinforced why I decided to run for Congress in the first place—to increase opportunity for everyday Americans who deserve a life full of dignity, prosperity and equity, but are too often left behind. I know what it’s like to work twice as hard, and get half as far; to sacrifice, only to be taken advantage of by those with power. I will make it my mission in Congress to ensure the people of this district finally get a fair shot at living out their dreams.But first, we must win the primary election in March. To do this, our campaign will organize an effort to meet voters where they are, from DeSoto to Oak Cliff to Downtown Dallas. Mark your calendars—Election Day is March 1st and early voting begins on February 14th.**However, I can’t do this alone. I need your support TODAY.

The end-of–year fundraising deadline is here. Many will use the numbers in this report to determine whether our campaign is able to compete in this election—let’s show them we are not only competitive, but ready to win!**
---
|
---
**In honor of District 30, can I count on you to make a
$30 contribution ahead of tomorrow’s deadline?**

| [ DONATE $30 ](https://abelfortexas.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6097af3608cb27432006e1b74&id=c2f4a8d79d&e=2dc92facb0)

|

Thank you again for fueling our campaign.

Happy Holidays and hope to see you in the New Year!

Your friend,

When we made history in 2018 by electing Nevada’s first Democratic Governor in two decades, many cynics said it was a fluke.
Well, I don’t think that’s true.
If I’ve learned anything these past three years, it’s that everything we have been able to accomplish has been the direct result of this team’s grit, passion, and commitment to making progress in our state.
The legislative accomplishments we made — **raising teacher salaries, introducing a public health insurance option, common sense gun control, raising the minimum wage** — are all on the line in this election.
We worked so hard to get these things done, and now we have to work hard to hold on to them.
I know that this team is ready to do whatever it takes to keep making progress in Battleground Nevada — and that starts with making sure this campaign is well resourced and able to take on my 6 Republican opponents.
**[So, will you chip in $5 or more right now to help me reach my end-of-year fundraising goal? clean_body: | | | | | Hi folks, it’s Steve Sisolak. This race is heating up, and there’s no shortage of reasons why it’s crucial that we defend this seat and Keep Nevada Blue. Before I get into why it’s so important that we give this fight our all, | | | When we made history in 2018 by electing Nevada’s first Democratic Governor in two decades, many cynics said it was a fluke. Well, I don’t think that’s true. If I’ve learned anything these past three years, it’s that everything we have been able to accomplish has been the direct result of this team’s grit, passion, and commitment to making progress in our state. The legislative accomplishments we made — raising teacher salaries, introducing a public health insurance option, common sense gun control, raising the minimum wage — are all on the line in this election. We worked so hard to get these things done, and now we have to work hard to hold on to them. My name is Wynne Winter. I’m Tom’s mom. I’m beyond proud of the campaign he’s running. Tom was raised to have empathy and understanding for others, to speak up and out against hate and injustice, and to always lead with kindness.

When Tom first told me he was considering running for Congress, I was all in from day one. Montanans are working as hard as ever but don’t have the same opportunities to provide for themselves and their children as we did for Tom and his siblings. It’s been nearly a year since the insurrection, and it feels like our communities are only growing further apart.

**My son is ready to put in the tough work to give our democracy a chance. Tom is a hardworking, courageous person, with a huge heart, who will seek solutions to solve problems, particularly in challenging times, and bring us together. He knows the future of our country is at stake if we don’t defeat corrupt politicians like Ryan Zinke.**

_**[But if Tom is going to have a shot at winning this race, he’s going to need help from a lot more than just his dear old mom! He tells me he’s about halfway toward their $25,000 FEC fundraising goal. That’s why I’m asking you to make a donation of $3 to his campaign before the deadline hits tomorrow.](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953y9EMk1-51Kul8D8mBdqO3ZCfg-oxqEls-YAMwdzS4Dd552cjrH82QTTw2paIdMFAqZ6qvvgeZlZPCetEmgORr0TRINKrg-M7DWsj3UuMmo-VnnrLDzTibeenQU9jigCNWu2BbOYLgXQJ7OpQzwSS0hQ9FDJy1Kv_zDKfPiy4661b-lNvYK0GGjwNFaumkz8-6Upbs8k_C9tM9Mte00lPNZgEjR2zEoD3XippFa9Of1pfITg0CtbULGTmDPZJ8LPDbmNijIbnU-F1bTY_2V20sFXYOozR4x1nLzejQR3tQucby0XHIg8KBF5Q0rUtb6FgcDpIaRLOjeGeLZCGvBkOFZ/3ia/YNmR2JBQT0yJzByqqojmug/h1/Kx_8e8i7ckV3u49WSf6SehltDjdc3omOiLAMjRJUwBo)**_

I check in with Tom every afternoon to get an update on the campaign. He and his dog Gary have been traveling the western part of the state for the last few days. It’s been so heartening to hear what Tom has learned from folks who care just as deeply for Montana, and our country, as we do.

>From Missoula to Kalispell and everywhere in between, Tom has been meeting with neighbors to listen to their concerns, ideas and their hopes for the future. Montanans want, and deserve, fair wages, homes, healthcare, and education. Together, I believe with all my heart that we can do this!

name: Ryan Busse
subject: The Second Amendment and sensible legislation are not in disagreement
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I’m reaching out about Giffords’ $300,000 December goal, and it’s important.
#

Hi friends, Ryan Busse here. I’m reaching out about Giffords’ $300,000 December goal and why it’s so important.
I worked in the gun industry for more than two decades so I’ve seen firsthand how the firearms industry and its lobby, especially the NRA, has become dangerously absolutist about the Second Amendment.
Like me, Gabby Giffords is a gun owner who knows that commonsense gun safety laws and the Second Amendment go hand-in-hand. Together with Gabby and the team at Giffords, we are continuing to build a home for responsible gun owners who reject the extremism of the gun industry and who understand that our freedoms are coupled with immense responsibility.
We calculated that $300,000 is exactly the amount we need to raise by the end of the year so we have the resources to fight back against the gun lobby’s unhinged campaign to unravel decades of gun safety and overpower the voices of responsible gun owners.
So, I’m personally asking:
[**Will you make a $3 contribution towards our $300,000 End of Year fundraising goal? Your contribution will go directly towards fighting back against the gun lobby.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-dec21-eom?refcode=em211230-1-30&t=1&refcode2=1405_3935704_Vr_L3V&akid=1405%2E3935704%2EVr_L3V)
**[DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-dec21-eom?refcode=em211230-1-30&t=2&refcode2=1405_3935704_Vr_L3V&akid=1405%2E3935704%2EVr_L3V)**
We can reduce gun violence and promote sensible gun ownership through policy reform. But in order to do so, we need to hold the firearms industry accountable and fight back against the gun lobby.
It’s critical that you donate before our deadline tomorrow at midnight. We need to end the year on a strong note and prove to the gun lobby that nothing is stopping us from protecting our families and communities.
I know that the Second Amendment and keeping Americans safe through reasonable legislation are not in disagreement.
Your support will help us to stop the NRA from spreading extremism and fuel our efforts to pass commonsense gun safety laws like universal background checks that benefit all Americans—including responsible gun owners.
Thank you for your part in saving lives.
Ryan Busse
Senior Advisor, Giffords

Peter

First off, I want to wish you a belated Merry Christmas and take this opportunity to wish you a joyous new year. This has been quite the year and fortunately for us, it's coming to a swift close. Next up: 2022 - the year of the Republican takeover of Washington.

While we certainly have the momentum behind us, we can't risk blowing it by not preparing ahead or taking the Democrat threat seriously.

That's why, one last time in 2021, **[I'm writing to see if you can possibly spare a couple of dollars to help me and my team hit our end of year fundraising goal.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59135701:6VF9lYEND:m:1:3253819041:8D3BDB8228813815A54C9A87F3947CB5:r)**

I said it then and I'll say it again now: we're still looking for additional donors at this time to help ensure every Republican campaign - including my own - has the opportunity to run the most effective race possible next year.

**[That's why we're humbly asking that you make a contribution of $5, $10, $25, or even just $1 before midnight tonight.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59135701:6VF9lYEND:m:1:3253819041:8D3BDB8228813815A54C9A87F3947CB5:r)
**

If you've been planning to make a donation this year and haven't yet done so, please take a moment to read the email I sent out before Christmas (**and copied below**) so you know why your buy-in is so important.

Thank you,
Jim

Every liberal political activist, consultant and media personality in the country is going to be watching out for the Q4 year-end fundraising report once we release it in early January. **Pelosi is targeting conservatives in races in all 50 states and she has more money than she knows what to do with.**

**Pelosi is RUTHLESS and she will do everything in her power to make sure we FAIL.**

We’ll start with the **good news,** friend. » Eric is picking up serious momentum in NC-14. He's locked in dozens of local endorsements, and Democrats are beginning to see Eric as the best candidate to replace Madison Cawthorn. That’s huge.

» **But there is some bad news:** Cawthorn and Donald Trump are not letting go so easily. Cawthorn just endorsed an extremist cut from his same cloth, and we expect National Republicans to begin flooding the airwaves to keep this seat red. | | Dear Fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

body:
You can now own one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, “Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,” on DVD.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zh76jbm7nomov8qbqfalcps3ekrgscvh41ftqkkg_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjg6cob1chh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm4qj6d9jmpqj7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65stlcdh62shm69g71dj36mr74cj26oqe1phgs1qmco7161qeed1l6lr7dcrgckoefkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup30phimspmcdti6hj31c5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)
This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zd92a69vpsoef4b4320e6tp98st3tn3c9j6ufdeo_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjg6cob1chh2bs) Dear Fellow American, You can now own one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,”** on DVD. Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, _**and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.**_ In recent years Winston Churchill, who is best known for his leadership during World War II, has been portrayed in numerous films and television shows, proving without a doubt that Americans find the “British Bulldog” captivating. The reasons for this sustained interest in Churchill are profound. No statesman has better diagnosed the threat of modern technology; no statesman has spoken more effectively in opposition to socialism; and, no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny. It should come as little surprise that so many “academics” and activists are working to smear his legacy, which makes studying a true account of Churchill’s accomplishments more important than ever. **For precisely this reason, I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set:** **_[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjohp4dt9g755ijnabrvgrs392slulejmahtnf20_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjg6cob1chh2bs)_** As a student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill will teach you more about this subject than any of the many books and videos available to you, and they will reveal profound lessons that can be applied to the urgent problems of today. [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z282mbpgi0469qi0338e9utf99os67g77sn17gs0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjg6cob1chh2bs) Only a limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you’ll take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give it as a gift—before they’re gone. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship** ” on DVD: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zoltr3ocb6an8if64lhmopa8nc1mmbekk5vdvr30_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjg6cob1chh2bs)_ You’ll undoubtedly enjoy this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ‘09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College |

Trump December 29th, 2021 In one year, Biden has caused a border crisis, an energy crisis, an inflation crisis, a labor crisis, a supply chain crisis, and a violent crime crisis—all while pushing the most radical left-wing agenda in history. THE MOST ANTI-WORKER, ANTI-FAMILY, ANTI-AMERICA PRESIDENT EVER: Joe Biden inherited the most secure border in history, the fastest economic recovery on record, historically low gas prices, hard-won American Energy Independence, a domestic manufacturing renaissance, and a nation poised to flourish like never before—all thanks to the America-First agenda of President Trump. It took less than 12 months for Biden and the extremists in his party to turn it all into crisis, chaos, misery, and woe. It’s no wonder Biden is ending his first year with his approval ratings tanking to an all-time record low. Even the media cannot cover up his dismal record of unrelenting failure: Inflation is the highest in nearly 40 years—decimating the wages and incomes of hardworking Americans. Gas prices have risen nearly 50% from one year ago. America’s southern border is GONE—with 2+ million illegal aliens flooding into the U.S. this year—the most ever recorded by far. Democrat-run cities across the country are hitting ALL-TIME HIGHS in murders and violent crime. Mass smash-and-grab robberies and lootings are taking place in cities and suburbs nationwide. Biden is pushing $5+ TRILLION in socialist spending bills crammed with nation-wrecking left-wing lunacy. Biden’s Radical Democrat Party is forcing CRT into our children’s schools, shoving male athletes onto women’s sports teams, pushing woke racism into our military, tearing down statues of Thomas Jefferson, desecrating our history, dismantling basic election-integrity measures, and breaking decades of precedent to use taxpayer dollars to fund late-term abortion and infanticide. It’s all happening exactly as President Trump predicted. Joe Biden is a DISASTER. THE “BIDENFLATION” DISASTER: IMPOVERISHING THE MIDDLE CLASS, CRUSHING THE AMERICAN DREAM Biden repeatedly promised that he would not raise taxes on anyone making “under $400,000”—a promise he has already tried to break many times. In reality, Biden’s out-of-control spending binge has triggered skyrocketing inflation that functions as a massive tax on EVERYTHING, at every income level—hitting working- and Middle-Class Americans hardest of all. Every American is poorer because Joe Biden is president. We have seen huge, double-digit increases in the price of cars, trucks, beef, bacon, eggs, sugar, pork, furniture, housing, and other staples of Middle Class life. But wages and incomes have not gone up to match. Real average weekly earnings (adjusted for inflation) have declined 8 months in a row —starting right after Biden signed his $2 trillion “American Rescue Plan” last spring. According to a December Gallup poll, 7 in 10 low-income Americans reported hardship due to rising prices. The Penn Wharton Budget Model estimates that Bidenflation will cost American families 6% of their budget this year, or $3,500—a humungous Biden tax increase on hardworking families. Joe Biden was WARNED about the inflation nightmare he was creating. In February, top Obama economic advisor Larry Summers warned publicly that Biden’s far-left agenda “will set off inflationary pressures of a kind we have not seen in a generation.” But Biden did not listen , charging ahead with his socialist programs and saying in July of this year, “Some folks have raised worries that this could be a sign of persistent inflation. But that's not our view. Our experts believe and the data shows that most of the price increases we've seen are—were expected and expected to be temporary.” Biden’s Chief of Staff contemptuously dismissed concerns about rising costs as “high class problems.” Now Biden is preposterously trying to claim that his latest $5 trillion spending bill “will take the pressure off of inflation”—an idea that not a single credible economist anywhere in the world believes. Instead, Larry Summers continues to warn that “there is significant reason to think inflation may accelerate” even further. As Democrat Senator Joe Manchin said of Biden’s signature legislative priority: “ This is a recipe for an economic crisis.” BIDEN’S ERA OF ECONOMIC MISERY: JOB HOPES DASHED, GROWTH FORCASTS SLASHED, MILLIONS OF FORGOTTEN AMERICANS DISAPPEARING FROM THE LABOR FORCE In November, Biden claimed that “This recovery is faster, stronger, fairer and wider than almost anyone could have predicted.” FALSE. For the last four straight months , the number of jobs added to the economy fell short of expectations. Last month, the number of jobs created fell short of expectations by 360,000. The MISERY INDEX (a combination of the inflation and unemployment rates) has reached its highest level in nearly three decades under Biden. Consumer sentiment is now lower under Biden than at ANY time during the Trump presidency. Small business optimism fell to a record low after the election. Under President Trump, small business optimism soared to the highest level ever recorded. Biden’s socialist American Rescue Plan created a disastrous labor shortage by paying millions of people more money NOT to work— long after most Americans were vaccinated and Biden had declared victory over the pandemic. Record numbers of Americans have left the workforce under Biden, with 4.3 million dropping out of the workforce in August alone. Under Biden, the Congressional Budget Office has downgraded their long-term projections of economic growth compared to their estimates last year (even after the worst of the pandemic shutdowns). In July 2020, CBO projected average real GDP growth of 2.1% from 2025-2030. Now CBO is projecting that average real GDP growth will be just 1.6% for 2026-2031, marking a decrease of nearly 24%. The July 2020 report projected that real GDP growth would be well above 2% EVERY year from 2024-2028. CBO’s latest estimate projects that real GDP growth will not exceed 1.6% during ANY of those years. By contrast, President Trump’s economy SHATTERED PREDICTIONS. At the end of the Obama administration, the CBO projected 2 million jobs would be created within 3 years. Instead, America gained 7 million new jobs before the pandemic – more than three times the experts’ predictions. In the first 2 months of 2020 (before the pandemic), the U.S. economy added more jobs than CBO had projected would be created in the entire 12 months of 2020. The strong economy that President Trump built put America on track for a swift rebound after the pandemic. In 2020, third quarter GDP growth was the largest ever at 33.1 percent. Household net worth rose to an all-time high in Q2 2020. Unemployment quickly fell to half its pandemic peak. President Trump’s economy rapidly regained over half of the jobs lost, much faster than projected. The Trump economic recovery was the fastest in recorded history —with jobs regained 23 times faster than they were after the financial crisis in 2008 under the Obama-Biden administration. Even despite the pandemic and the pandemic-induced economic setbacks, Gallup found 56 percent of Americans felt that they were better off at the end of President Trump’s first term than they were when it started. NOW BIDEN IS PUSHING THE LARGEST TAX INCREASE IN AMERICAN HISTORY—PUNISHING AMERICAN WORKERS AND REWARDING OUTSOURCERS WHO SEND JOBS TO CHINA According to the non-partisan Joint Committee on Taxation, the Biden spending bill would RAISE TAXES on working families at virtually EVERY income level, and lower after-tax incomes of 80 percent of Americans. Even the liberal Tax Policy Center says Biden’s Build Back Better Act raises taxes on the Middle Class. The Biden tax plan is pro-China, anti-America. His plan would make the U.S. business tax rate dramatically higher than the tax rate in Communist China. Taking into account all taxes under Biden’s plan, the Democrat bill would give businesses an approximately 100 percent tax advantage to locate jobs in China , rather than in the United States. It’s a tax cut for outsourcers, paid for with the jobs and livelihoods of American Workers. Biden also rescinded President Trump’s “2-for-1” cap on job-killing regulations, and resumed the regulatory behemoth’s relentless mission to keep jobs out of the United States. Meanwhile, Biden promised in the campaign “not cut taxes for the super wealthy,” but that is exactly what he is fighting to do in his regressive tax plan. The “Build Back Better” bill provides nearly $300 billion to increase the cap on the state and local tax deduction. 98% of this tax cut would go to households making over six figures. While Biden’s policies hurt middle and low-income earners, President Trump’s America-First policies created the greatest economy in the history of the world: Record low African-American, Hispanic American, and Asian American unemployment rates. Record low unemployment among Native Americans, individuals with disabilities, veterans, and those without a high school diploma. Unemployment for women also reached its lowest rate in nearly 70 years. Under President Trump, a record number of people between ages 25 and 34 were working. Record low poverty rates for Americans of every race and ethnic group—including record low Black and Hispanic American poverty rates. Real median-household income hit an ALL TIME HIGH. subject: Bureaucrats Push Critical Race Theory vs School Safety
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michael Brown for Governor • P
body:
Law enforcement’s job in assessing potential threats is hard enough. When bureaucrats refuse to comply with the law, it makes the job more difficult. | | | |
---
| | |
## Critical Race Theory
vs School Safety
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| Peter: We're two days before the new year, and one of the biggest under-reported stories of 2020 to me is the fact that our school districts are failing in their responsibility to provide a safe learning environment for our kids.

In light of the tragedy at Oxford High School we should be demanding answers.

_[Did you know that in 2020 only 4% of schools followed the law and actively reported incidents or attempted incidents for a range of crimes?](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=471cb8481f&e=0636b97700)_

Crimes such as assault (physical or sexual), theft, and arson are all tracked by the Michigan State Police, and school districts are _required to report these incidents_ within 24 hours of their occurrence.

**The problem is _school districts are not following the law and reporting_. **This makes law enforcement's job all the more difficult.

So, who is to blame?

It's easy to point the finger at local schools or school district bureaucrats. Ultimately, though, _the blame falls squarely on the Governor_.

Governor Whitmer has the bully pulpit to demand accountability. The state school superintendent sits as a member of her cabinet.

Yet, Whitmer turns a blind eye, and the school superintendent seems more focused on **promoting "critical race theory"** to our kids. He actually brags about it in his biography on the state website.

_Governor Whitmer is failing our students and our communities._ Why is she not making sure the superintendent and the school districts follow the law and report crimes?

It's only common sense. How can law enforcement do its job when its hands are tied by bureaucrats _more concerned about social justice agendas than safety of our kids_?

Peter, you have my commitment that as Governor I will ensure that our schools provide a safe environment for students and teachers. I will insist that every member of the education bureaucracy follows the law, and that our schools work hand-in-hand with law enforcement to identify potential threats.
---
|
---
| [DONATE TODAY](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=25f1d8bd44&e=0636b97700 "DONATE TODAY")
---
| Studies are showing that **Governor Whitmer’s pandemic response of lockdowns and isolation have caused tremendous harm to our students**. Feelings of depression and anxiety are at an all time high.

Students throughout the state have been [virtually crippled](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=cfa7187007&e=0636b97700) from nearly two years of pandemic shutdowns and disruptions.

Whatever the causes of the angst among our young ones _we must be equipped to identify potential threats of violence before they occur_.

We’re not trying to turn teachers into police officers. Far from it. Their job is difficult enough.

But we have tools available right now that are not being utilized — and the chief tool is communication.

School districts are simply not communicating with law enforcement. The bureaucrats at the top are so focused on critical race theory that they ignore this dire need. This has to stop.

There is a bill moving through the legislature, [SB 789 by Senator Ruth Johnson](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=9e0c77ab4f&e=0636b97700), that would strengthen reporting requirements. **I fully support this effort, yet it should not be necessary.**

If a violent incident occurs on a campus any reasonable person would agree that law enforcement must be made aware so they can investigate and assess whether there is a potential for an escalated threat.

And school districts are already required to report incidents but they are failing to do so.

We must ask, “why?”
* **Why are they refusing to report incidents that could help prevent the next tragic shooting?**

* **Why is our State School Superintendent not pushing school districts to report violent incidents? **

* **Why is Governor Whitmer turning a blind eye to the problem?**

Law enforcement analyzes trends to try to get ahead of any potential threats. To do this effectively we need accurate data and that only comes from communication.

Extreme incidents like the Oxford High School shooting are rare, but still, _there is no excuse for not using all of our available tools to lessen the chances of further incidents_.

I’m a product of public schools. While I absolutely support allowing parents more choice — including giving more options for charter schools, private schools, and homeschooling — I believe in our public schools and our school teachers.

As Governor, I’ll use the power of my office to insist that our State School Superintendent, the State Board of Education, and the Michigan Department of Education work together with law enforcement so we can better ensure that our students are in a safe learning environment.

They deserve no less.

If you agree, please consider making a generous donation to my campaign before the end of the year. $100, $50, $25 ... any amount helps.

We must band together to defeat Gretchen Whitmer. We can turn this state around and fix Michigan – for our kids, our neighbors, and friends.

>From the campaign trail,

Michael Brown
Conservative Republican for Governor

P.S. The state legislature established the [OK2SAY](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=842edd280a&e=0636b97700) tip line as a tool for anonymous reporting of tips about school-related crimes, or potential harm to safety of students, teachers, and staff. More than 29,000 tips have been made via phone, text and email. The program is managed by the Michigan State Police.

[1]Charles Booker

Peter, will you
chip in $17.52 to help us reach our final 2021 fundraising goal
tomorrow?

(Keep reading and we’ll tell you why this amount)

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14355?refcode=em20211230-1388&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=1388%2E346206%2Edvt-co ]CHIP IN $17.52 →

Let us explain,
Peter.

We’re proud to share that our average online donation is $17.52.

That might not seem like a lot, but there’s a lot of power in that number.

This number represents the grassroots movement we’re building right here
in Kentucky: teachers, fast food workers, coal miners, nurses, students,
and believers in change are coming together and chipping in whatever they
can to help defeat Rand Paul and elect Charles.

That’s powerful,
Peter. If we keep fighting like
this, putting our $17.52 donations together — we’re confident we can
finally hold Rand Paul accountable for his corruption and lies — and
replace him with a leader who will actually fight for US.

Charles knows what it’s like to struggle to make ends meet, to choose
between affording medication and groceries, to lose loved ones to gun
violence. He’s determined to put the challenges and issues everyday people
in Kentucky face at the center of our campaign, but we’re relying on
supporters like you to power this work.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14355?refcode=em20211230-1388&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=1388%2E346206%2Edvt-co ]Will you chip in $17.52 or anything you can to help make sure our
campaign hits our big end-of-year fundraising goal so we can send Charles
to the U.S. Senate next year? It’s critical that we’re prepared to
massively expand our organizing and voter outreach programs in 2022.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14355?refcode=em20211230-1388&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=1388%2E346206%2Edvt-co ]DONATE NOW →

$17.52 may not be a lot compared to the average donations of other
campaigns — but that’s what sets Team Booker apart.

We’re creating a movement that represents the many and not the few. That’s
why we don’t accept a single cent from special interests or corporations.

We believe this kind of strategy is our strongest chance to mobilize
voters from the hood to the holler, defeat Rand Paul, and expand our
majority in the Senate so we can finally pass the urgent policies we need.

But it also means we’re really relying on grassroots supporters like you
to help out as we prepare to take on Rand Paul’s war chest of corporate
money.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14355?refcode=em20211230-1388&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=1388%2E346206%2Edvt-co ]Will you give $17.52 or anything you can today to help us hit our
goal? We only have one more day to raise 5,000 grassroots donations before
our end-of-year deadline, so any amount you can give makes a big
difference.

Together,

Team Booker

| Peter, As we wrap up 2021, I wanted to take a moment to highlight just one of President Trump’s comments about my campaign for the U.S. Senate. I am proud to have the support of President Trump in my conservative campaign for the U.S. Senate. To listen to this click [here](https://mobrooksforsen.nationbuilder.com/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYl5kI5FGvvVrRHG_uYbe7Rnj6G4bHIJVuhCn90nqe52cveewIUapkpeW-P4IhARc0g&e=2bb0250de6a743cf472d1821e5b3b009&utm_source=mobrooksforsen&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_ad_list_2&n=2). Here is the official transcript of the ad: _Transcript:_ _President Trump said:_ "Hi Alabama, this is your favorite President, Donald Trump. | | Folks, Charles Graham has served in North Carolina’s General Assembly for 10 years, and in 2020, Donald Trump won the part of North Carolina that includes Charles’ State House District by _**22 points.**_ That’s a pretty hefty margin, folks. And yet, that same year Democrat Charles Graham defeated his Republican opponent for a seat in the General Assembly by just _1,344 votes._ This tells us two things:

Georgia's Senate race will almost certainly decide who controls the Senate Majority and the direction of our nation. # Thank you for a fabulous 2021 start!

Hello everyone! I wanted to thank you for helping my campaign get off to such a strong start for 2021. You ain't seen nuthin' yet! 2022 is going to be amazing.

I have traveled to all 36 Oregon counties, some many times. EVERY county is important to me. I have held public events in all but a couple counties, and those are in the process of being scheduled for February or March. I had the most small, grassroots donations of any Republican candidate last month. (The Union County Republican Chair tracks these stats consistently.) When my campaign analyzes my social media and web site stats, the most new visitors are coming in order from: Portland, Medford, Salem, Baker City (my home base!), Bend, LaGrande, Eugene, Lebanon, Roseburg and Ashland. Then we have ties with some pretty substantial numbers between about a dozen other cities all over the state (Coos Bay, K-Falls, Beaverton...) I'm seeing the same trends in those of you who have signed up for yard signs and this email list. Our grassroots army is building _everywhere_! I'm excited.

Finally, this will be my last email of the year asking for campaign donations. I know you all get sick of seeing the political begging in your inbox, but unfortunately, donations are the lifeblood of a campaign, and if I don't ask, I don't receive! There are only two days left to use your 2021 political tax credit. _Truly, every Oregonian should take advantage of this! This is one of those rare times you'll know exactly where at least some of your money went once you file that return._ Just donate $50 to my campaign ($100 for couples filing jointly.) When you file your state taxes, just check the political tax credit box. This is a CREDIT, not a deduction. It’s like a free donation, and it’s a great way to help keep grassroots power in Oregon’s elections. _**Please chip in today! **_ Your donations help me stop my wealthy, politically connected opposition from buying the primary. Your donations help me continue across the state on the campaign trail. They buy TV, newspaper, radio and billboard ads. They allow me to get yard signs and a listing in the Oregon Voter's Pamphlet.**I'm willing to do all the work it takes, but I can't do it without you.**

Yours,
_Kerry_

Fellow American,

**Our campaign is THE top target of the national Democrats.**

They're nervous because they must re-elect my opponent - who calls himself the most vulnerable incumbent Senate Democrat - in order to keep complete control of the federal government.

_And they will be watching Team Herschel's fourth quarter numbers closely._

At the end of this month, we will close the books on fundraising for 2021. |
It's almost 2022!
Happy New Year, everyone!
Are you ready to hit the ground running? At the Heidi St. John for Congress campaign, we're already gearing up for an exciting season of campaigning--and the focus is on YOU, the citizens of Southwest Washington State.
In my travels across our district, I hear the same things over and over: people are ready for new leadership. The good people of Washington state are tired of the lack of leadership we have been living under for the past decade. They're tired of electing people who don't reflect their values or push to make positive changes for their families.
As a business owner and job creator, I want to see regulations lifted so that our people can thrive, create, and grow.
As a mother and grandmother, I remain deeply concerned about the state of our schools. Critical Race Theory, which has been getting federal money, is a disgrace to our country and a divisive tool of the Marxist left. The government should never give money to schools that are promoting this racist ideology. It's time to give parents school choice and the opportunity to hold their schools accountable for the things that they are teaching our children.
The federal government is totally out of control, and I intend to work hard to shine a bright light on the many issues that are frustrating the people of our area: from federal interference in education to the never-ending mandates that are hurting our kids and our economy every day. The federal government has turned into a bureaucratic nightmare. From high taxes to rising inflation, it's time to send people to Congress who know what it takes to start and run a successful business and who have a demonstrated record of working for the communities they are running to represent.
Let's make 2022 the year we send committed Conservatives to Washington DC, and I'm here ready to represent you. I hope you will get involved in my campaign in the days and weeks to come! We have a wonderful staff in the office who can't wait to plug you in. Representative government requires that we all get involved, and I can't wait to work with you to bring positive change to our area in 2022 and beyond.
Happy New Year!

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | ---|--- | It's almost 2022! Happy New Year, everyone! Are you ready to hit the ground running? At the Heidi St. John for Congress campaign, we're already gearing up for an exciting season of campaigning--and the focus is on YOU, the citizens of Southwest Washington State. In my travels across our district, I hear the same things over and over: people are ready for new leadership. The good people of Washington state are tired of the lack of leadership we have been living under for the past decade. They're tired of electing people who don't reflect their values or push to make positive changes for their families. As a business owner and job creator, I want to see regulations lifted so that our people can thrive, create, and grow. As a mother and grandmother, I remain deeply concerned about the state of our schools. Critical Race Theory, which has been getting federal money, is a disgrace to our country and a divisive tool of the Marxist left. The government should never give money to schools that are promoting this racist ideology. It's time to give parents school choice and the opportunity to hold their schools accountable for the things that they are teaching our children. The federal government is totally out of control, and I intend to work hard to shine a bright light on the many issues that are frustrating the people of our area: from federal interference in education to the never-ending mandates that are hurting our kids and our economy every day. The federal government has turned into a bureaucratic nightmare. From high taxes to rising inflation, it's time to send people to Congress who know what it takes to start and run a successful business and who have a demonstrated record of working for the communities they are running to represent. Let's make 2022 the year we send committed Conservatives to Washington DC, and I'm here ready to represent you. I hope you will get involved in my campaign in the days and weeks to come! We have a wonderful staff in the office who can't wait to plug you in. Representative government requires that we all get involved, and I can't wait to work with you to bring positive change to our area in 2022 and beyond. name: David Horowitz
subject: America is on the brink of destruction
body:
America is on the brink of destruction. I don't say this to shock you or scare you --_I say it because it 's true._ And I say it with confidence because when I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. **My name is David Horowitz, and 50 years ago I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end.** I was side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited Ramparts - the largest magazine of the radical Left. I marched, I wrote manifestos, and I attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam, and my eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan and never looked back. I created the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left, and dedicated my life to exposing them. I did it because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing, I knew what was at stake, and I knew that if I didn't tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. **[Today, I'm asking you to join me in this fight, and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $45 or more to my Freedom Center.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59134547:JVaqVYEdN:m:1:3253819041:9A3A066E396B597E9D9D0698DDF53630:r)** _What we 're seeing today didn't happen overnight. It's no coincidence. It's no stroke of luck._ **It 's the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making.** For decades now, the Freedom Center has been in the trenches, exposing this sinister movement and warning of what was to come. America's domestic enemies have smeared us every step of the way, and worked around the clock to cut off both political and financial support to silence us for good. We've been targeted by MasterCard, DiscoverCard, the Southern Poverty Law Center, and so many more because we're willing to say and do what no one else would to expose the enemy within. That's why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain what is happening in this battle now - how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party... ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of the country... ...how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state, and to cancel, de-platform, and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as "white supremacists" and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59134547:JVaqVYEdN:m:1:3253819041:9A3A066E396B597E9D9D0698DDF53630:r) **" A Great Book" - Dinesh D'Souza** **" The Enemy Within is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life." - Mark Levin** **" David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation." Laura Ingraham** I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because I knew that if America stood a chance, Americans had to understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because I was the enemy within -- and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because we've reached the point in our history that will decide our future -- and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[So if you donate $45 or more to the Freedom Center today](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59134547:JVaqVYEdN:m:1:3253819041:9A3A066E396B597E9D9D0698DDF53630:r)** and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left's evil agenda to every American patriot, I will send you a complimentary copy _The Enemy Within._ The Left is at war with America. They don't simply disagree with us about how to make it better -- they want to destroy it and make way for their Marxist dystopia. **And they don 't care how much they have to lie, cheat, or steal to achieve it.** So it's up to patriots like you and me to show our fellow Americans who they really are and what they really want while we still can. Sincerely, David Horowitz P.S. I know how we got to this point in our country, and I know how we get out. But the clock is ticking, and our country is hanging by a thread. **[Please make a generous donation of $45 or more to the Freedom Center today](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59134547:JVaqVYEdN:m:1:3253819041:9A3A066E396B597E9D9D0698DDF53630:r)** , and as a thank you for your generous support, I'll reserve a complimentary copy of my latest book _The Enemy Within_ for you, explaining this in depth. [**Get Your Exclusive Copy of _The Enemy Within_**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59134547:JVaqVYEdN:m:1:3253819041:9A3A066E396B597E9D9D0698DDF53630:r) | |

body:
President Joe Biden spent his first year as president making one embarrassing mistake after another on issues important to Americans and while representing the United States. -- President Joe Biden spent his first year as president making one embarrassing mistake after another on issues important to Americans and while representing the United States. Here are the top 25 worst moments from 2021: 25. Joe Biden Rips Coast Guard Graduates During Commencement Speech In May 2021, Biden ridiculed Coast Guard graduates after they did not react to a line in his commencement speech that he wanted to elicit applause. “Why you’re a real dull class. I mean, c’mon man, is the sun getting to you? I would think you’d have an opportunity when I say that about the Navy to clap,” Biden said, appearing irritated. The White House / YouTube 24. clean_body: President Joe Biden spent his first year as president making one embarrassing mistake after another on issues important to Americans and while representing the United States. -- President Joe Biden spent his first year as president making one embarrassing mistake after another on issues important to Americans and while representing the United States. Here are the top 25 worst moments from 2021: 25. Joe Biden Rips Coast Guard Graduates During Commencement Speech In May 2021, Biden ridiculed Coast Guard graduates after they did not react to a line in his commencement speech that he wanted to elicit applause. “Why you’re a real dull class. I mean, c’mon man, is the sun getting to you? I would think you’d have an opportunity when I say that about the Navy to clap,” Biden said, appearing irritated. The White House / YouTube 24. Joe Biden Calls Australian PM ‘That Fella Down Under’ President Biden appeared to forget who he was talking to when he called Australia’s Prime Minister Scott Morrison “that fella down under.” “Thank you Boris and I want to thank uh… that fella Down Under,” Biden said, as he spoke with UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and Morrison during a video conference call. Scott Morrison, Tracey Nearmy/Getty Images   23. Joe Biden Loses Mask at Outdoor Event  In April, Biden lost his mask at an outdoor campaign event with Democrat Sens. Raphael Warnock and Jon Ossoff, stumbling and interrupting the event as he searched for it. “I’m looking for my mask. I’m in trouble,” Biden apologized to the crowd. Throughout 2021, Biden struggled with masking protocols as he repeatedly lectured critics of mask mandates as being unpatriotic. At times he appeared publicly with his mask, at other times he walked away from events without his mask and greeted the public. During a video climate summit call with world leaders, Biden was the only one at one point wearing a mask on camera. WARREN, MICHIGAN – SEPTEMBER 09: Democratic presidential nominee and former Vice President Joe Biden replaces the mask he wears to reduce the risk posed by coronavirus after addressing union members outside the United Auto Workers Region 1 offices on September 09, 2020 in Warren, Michigan. Biden is campaigning in Michigan, a state President Donald Trump won in 2016 by less than 11,000 votes, the narrowest margin of victory in state’s presidential election history. (Photo by Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images)   22. Joe Biden reverses reaction on Kyle Rittenhouse verdict In November 2021, President Joe Biden reacted to the verdict in the Kyle Rittenhouse trial by standing by the jury’s decision. “I stand by what the jury has to say,” Biden said shortly. “The jury system works and we have to abide by it.” Just hours later, the White House released a statement from Biden that said he was “angry and concerned” by the verdict, suggesting the jury’s decision was the wrong one. In this Oct. 21, 2021, file photo, President Joe Biden participates in a CNN town hall at the Baltimore Center Stage Pearlstone Theater, in Baltimore. North Korea on Saturday, Oct. 23, accused the Biden administration of raising military tensions with China with its “reckless” backing of Taiwan and claimed that the growing U.S. military presence in the region poses a potential threat to the North. (AP Photo/Evan Vucci, File) Kyle Rittenhouse looks back at the gallery in the courtroom as the room is let go for an afternoon break at the Kenosha County Courthouse in Kenosha, Wis., on Monday, Nov. 1, 2021. Rittenhouse, an aspiring police officer, shot two people to death and wounded a third during a night of anti-racism protests in Kenosha last year. (Sean Krajacic/The Kenosha News via AP, Pool)   21. Joe Biden says “I Agree” After Dad Says “Let’s Go, Brandon!” In December 2021, Biden appeared unfamiliar with the “Let’s Go Brandon!” chant popularized among his critics to voice their dissent with his presidency. During a NORAD Santa tracker call with his children, Jared Schmeck, 35, said the phrase to Biden, prompting the president to repeat the phrase and say “Let’s go Brandon. I agree.” Let’s Go Brandon 20. Biden Supports Major League Baseball’s Decision to Pull All-Star Game from Atlanta  In April 2021, Biden voiced support for Major League Baseball’s decision to pull the All-Star game from Atlanta in protest of Georgia’s election security laws. “I think today’s professional athletes are acting incredibly responsibly. I would strongly support them doing that,” Biden said in an ESPN interview. “People look to them. They’re leaders.” The boycott  cost the state of Georgia and the city of Atlanta an estimated $100 million and hurt minority-owned businesses, making it so unpopular that even Stacey Abrams shifted her position on the boycott. 19. Joe Biden Diplomatic Disaster Angers France In September 2021, France recalled their ambassador to America for the first time in the long history between the two nations after Biden and his administration made a nuclear submarine deal with Australia that canceled an existing multi-billion dollar deal with France. The French first learned about the deal in the media, not from the Americans or the Australians. Biden later admitted his blunder during a visit with French President Emmanuel Macron. “I think what happened was, to use an English phrase, what we did was clumsy, not done with a lot of grace,” Biden said. “I was under the impression that certain things had happened that hadn’t happened.” Macron Head Down 18. Joe Biden Paralyzed by Colonial Pipeline Hack  In May 2021, President Biden was left helpless after cybercriminals in Russia hacked the Colonial Pipeline, disrupting fuel supplies on the East Coast. In response, Biden asked Americans not to panic and to limit their fuel purchases until the “hiccup” was over. The federal government watched as Colonial Pipeline paid about $5 million in ransom to foreign hackers to free the pipeline. 17. Joe Biden Clueless as He Marvels at $4.50 a Gallon Gas Prices  In November 2021, Biden marveled at the high cost of gas, without acknowledging his policies that were hurting domestic oil production. “Did you ever think you’d be paying this much for a gallon of gas?” Biden said. “In some parts of California, they’re paying $4.50 a gallon.” The high cost of gas was a persistent problem throughout 2021, as Biden and his administration failed to enact more regulatory relief and policies that would actually increase domestic oil production and lower prices. On day one of his presidency, Biden revoked a crucial permit for the Keystone XL pipeline, halting construction of the project.Biden also ordered a pause on all oil and gas leases on federal lands. A pedestrian walks past gas station fuel prices above $5 and $6 per gallon at Death Valley National Park in June 17, 2021 in Furnace Creek, California. – Much of the western United States is braced for record heat waves this week, with approximately 50 million Americans placed on alert Tuesday for “excessive” temperatures, which could approach 120 degrees Fahrenheit (50 degrees Celsius) in some areas. The National Park Service warns of extreme summer heat, urging tourists to carry extra water and “travel prepared to survive” in the hottest, lowest, and driest national park featuring steady drought and extreme climates. (Photo by Patrick T. FALLON / AFP) (Photo by PATRICK T. FALLON/AFP via Getty Images) 16. Joe Biden Denounces Transgender Sports Bans as ‘Un-American’ In June 2021, Biden decried efforts by Republicans to ban biological males from competing in female sports as transgender women and wiping out the competition. “These are some of the ugliest, most un-American bills I’ve seen and I’ve been here a long time,” Biden said during a gay and transgender pride reception at the White House. “Let’s be clear. This is no more than bullying disguised as legislation,” he added. 15. Joe Biden Voices Dissent with Catholic Teaching on Abortion In September 2021, Biden declared he did not agree with the Catholic Church’s teaching on abortion — despite purporting to be a “devout Catholic.” “I respect those who believe life begins at the moment of conception and all … I respect that. Don’t agree. But I respect that,” Biden said. The president continued to defy Catholic teaching, even claiming after visiting Pope Francis that the pontiff told him he was still a good Catholic and to keep receiving communion. The Vatican did not comment on Biden’s assertion, citing the private nature of the conversation. US President Joe Biden, left, talks to Pope Francis as they meet at the Vatican, Friday, Oct. 29, 2021. President Joe Biden met with Pope Francis on Friday at the Vatican, where the world’s two most notable Roman Catholics plan to discuss the COVID-19 pandemic, climate change and poverty. name: Alexandra Rojas (via JusticeDemocrats.com)
subject: Bringing our power into 2022
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

This is an important email about our work heading into 2022. It’s long,
but please stick with me and read to the end.

In just a few years, Justice Democrats has made a major impact on politics
in Washington. In 2016, a bunch of us were Bernie campaign staffers and
super volunteers. We had just worked on his inspiring campaign for
president and were trying to figure out how to answer one important
question: How can we continue Bernie’s vision AND force Congress, and the
Democratic establishment, to prioritize a progressive agenda?

We launched in 2017 and it was really tough going at first. It’s not easy
to run a grassroots-funded organization fighting for progress — we know
how corporate donors and the political establishment will do anything to
protect the status quo. Through the initial struggle, the election of
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez made it all worth it.

When Justice Democrats recruited AOC to run, she was working as a
bartender — she even worked as a bartender for many months while running
for office. Sometimes that’s what it takes when you’re a working-class
candidate.

We helped AOC manage her team, run her organizing program, and make
everything we could of our small budget. Then, she won. We toppled one of
the most powerful corporate Democrats and elected the youngest woman ever
to serve in Congress in his place.

We were still funded 100% from the grassroots and fundraising continued to
be a huge challenge for us. The Democratic establishment and the
right-wing have unlimited amounts of money pouring in from Wall Street,
fossil fuel companies, Big Pharma, and health insurance executives. We’re
trying to defeat them with a fraction of the money corporate Democrats
have in their campaign accounts.

That’s why your support is so critical,
Peter. Most Congressional races
are won by the candidate with more money. Yet, we continue to win
primaries with less money because we have the message, organizing
operation, campaign experience, and grassroots energy behind us.

The election cycle after AOC won and the Squad took office, we helped
elect Jamaal Bowman, Cori Bush, and Marie Newman. We also helped defend
the Squad from primary challenges backed by Wall Street and the political
establishment. We’ve proven we can win.

This year we recruited five working-class progressives to take on the
Democratic establishment in 2022. And just days ago, we endorsed a sixth.
With your help we can elect Odessa Kelly, Rana Abdelhamid, Kina Collins,
Jessica Cisneros, Summer Lee, and Greg Casar, and continue making our mark
on Congress.

Together we can raise up a progressive agenda and build our progressive
bloc in Washington so we can finally pass Medicare for All and a Green New
Deal. Our first 2022 primaries are right around the corner — in-person
early voting for our Texas Justice Democrats, Jessica and Greg, starts on
February 14.

So today, I’m asking you to help us make 2022 a winning year for Justice
Democrats. I promise you that almost no other org will spend your money
more efficiently. If we can raise enough this year, I know we can elect
more new Justice Dems than ever before.

Peter, now is
the time to chip in and support strong progressive primaries. We need your
help to prepare for 2022. We could go from 10 to 16 Justice Democrats in
Congress, putting even more pressure on Wall Street-backed corporate
Democrats. Can you make a contribution today?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/88585?refcode=em20211230-21220&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=21220%2E1203867%2E7qb3p4 ]→ Yes, I can donate to Justice Democrats right now to help elect the
next generation of the Squad to Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/88585?refcode=em20211230-21220&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=21220%2E1203867%2E7qb3p4 ]Contribute

With your support, we’ll elect the next generation of Justice Democrats to
challenge corporate Democrats and start fighting for working people in the
halls of Congress.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas, Executive Director
Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1004&akid=21220%2E1203867%2E7qb3p4 ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1005&akid=21220%2E1203867%2E7qb3p4 ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20211230-21220-footer&t=1006&refcode2=21220_1203867_7qb3p4&akid=21220%2E1203867%2E7qb3p4

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1007&akid=21220%2E1203867%2E7qb3p4

PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee.
JusticeDemocrats.com
10629 Hardin Valley Rd, #226
Knoxville, TN 37932
Email us: us@justicedemocrats.com

Hageman hits all 23 Wyoming counties in first months of campaign
---
Since announcing her candidacy for the U.S. House of Representatives on September 9, Harriet Hageman has driven 9,042 miles within Wyoming, meeting with voters in all 23 counties in the state. She has also racked up an impressive list of endorsements in her bid to replace incumbent Rep. Liz Cheney, who rarely visits Wyoming. Hageman has also raised a majority of her campaign funds from the citizens of Wyoming – something that Cheney cannot say. “There is no question that my fellow Wyomingites want their only member of the House to reflect their values and beliefs, and they don’t have that right now with Liz Cheney,” Hageman said. “Everywhere I go – and I have traveled to a lot of places – people thank me for running because they are ready to have someone from Wyoming, someone who has fought for Wyoming, and someone with Wyoming in her DNA to represent them in Congress.” _**Communities visited:**_ Buffalo, Casper, Cheyenne, Cody, Cokeville, Douglas, Dubois, Evanston, Fort Laramie, Gillette, Jackson, Kemmerer, Laramie, Lovell, Lusk, Lyman, Newcastle, Pavilion, Pinedale, Riverton, Rock Springs, Saratoga, Sheridan, Sundance, Thayne, Thermopolis, Torrington, Wheatland, Worland. _**Key Endorsements:**_ President Donald J. clean_body: | | | | Hageman hits all 23 Wyoming counties in first months of campaign Since announcing her candidacy for the U.S. House of Representatives on September 9, Harriet Hageman has driven 9,042 miles within Wyoming, meeting with voters in all 23 counties in the state. She has also racked up an impressive list of endorsements in her bid to replace incumbent Rep. Liz Cheney, who rarely visits Wyoming. Hageman has also raised a majority of her campaign funds from the citizens of Wyoming – something that Cheney cannot say. “There is no question that my fellow Wyomingites want their only member of the House to reflect their values and beliefs, and they don’t have that right now with Liz Cheney,” Hageman said. “Everywhere I go – and I have traveled to a lot of places – people thank me for running because they are ready to have someone from Wyoming, someone who has fought for Wyoming, and someone with Wyoming in her DNA to represent them in Congress.” Communities visited: Buffalo, Casper, Cheyenne, Cody, Cokeville, Douglas, Dubois, Evanston, Fort Laramie, Gillette, Jackson, Kemmerer, Laramie, Lovell, Lusk, Lyman, Newcastle, Pavilion, Pinedale, Riverton, Rock Springs, Saratoga, Sheridan, Sundance, Thayne, Thermopolis, Torrington, Wheatland, Worland. Friend, From myself, my wife Lori, and sons Ethan and Garrett, we wish you and your family a Happy New Year! I hope you've been enjoying this time around the holidays with family and friends—it's a special time to reconnect and take a moment to reflect. As I think back to the holidays when I was serving in Iraq and wasn't able to spend time with loved ones, it truly makes me thankful for the brave men and women serving overseas or in the armed forces fighting to keep us safe, for the first responders who give and put so much on the line for the communities they serve, and for fellow veterans who sacrificed to serve our country. We are blessed beyond belief to be Americans and what unites us is so much more than what divides us. I'm excited to continue the fight to renew Illinois in 2022 and I hope you're excited to be part of this movement as well! I wish you and your family a Happy New Year. S/F, Paul Schimpf

body:
A $5 donation.
#

A $5 donation.
That’s what I’m humbly asking of you ahead of our FEC deadline tomorrow night.
$5 might not seem like much, especially compared to the millions of dollars Republicans will spend to try to flip this seat and undo all the progress we’ve made this year.
But when you chip in $5 — and Jordan from Los Angeles chips in $5, and Maria from Fresno gives $50, and Melissa in Merced adds their $25, it starts to add up pretty quickly.
That is how we are funding this campaign. Regular folks like you from across the country, chipping in a few dollars when they can because they believe in what we’re fighting for — like comprehensive immigration reform, universal health care, and a Green New Deal.
I’m incredibly proud of that fact, and you should be too. But that does mean that with less than 48 hours to go until our deadline, I have to ask:
[**Can I count on you to make a contribution — of $5 or whatever you can give — to our campaign today? \- Alex Padilla

Hello —

I am writing to you today to thank you for being such an important part of our campaign for U.S. Senate. We have only been in this race for a few months, and there is a long road ahead, but I am so proud of the grassroots team we’ve built together here.

Our public report will show the amount of money we have raised and, most importantly, the number of people who have contributed to help.

body:
We're 24 hrs away from our year end fundraising deadline. Here's why money matters, how we're using it, and how you can help close out the year strong | | | |
---
| | |
### Fundraising Deadline / Why $ Matters
Campaigning in a district that spans from the Delaware to the Hudson, includes 95 towns, and over 760,000 people is **not easy or cheap.**

But our work to flip the most competitive seat in the House, bring a generational change to Congress, and [unseat our most corrupt representative](https://johnisemann.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4fd963055e9fc7d57d7943691&id=ae9e806852&e=0a69e2b984) **could not be more important.

_We have just 24 hours to close out 2021 and complete our first fundraising quarter. Help us finish strong._ _[(DONATE HERE)](https://johnisemann.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4fd963055e9fc7d57d7943691&id=aa9281edce&e=0a69e2b984)_**

Your contributions help build our team, spread our message, and advance our mission. We're rethinking how campaigns are run and won -spending conservatively, working tirelessly, and a few of us - myself included - have quit our jobs to do this full time on no salary.

_**Join us to help save New Jersey and our country.
GIVE TODAY and help us reach our [YEAR END GOAL](https://johnisemann.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4fd963055e9fc7d57d7943691&id=ec21bac739&e=0a69e2b984)**_

body:
Tomorrow’s FEC deadline is the most important one of our campaign so far, and a big opportunity for our campaign.
#

Hi there,
**[Can you make your first contribution to Cheri Beasley's campaign today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-dec21?refcode=em211230-3-ma&refcode2=216.357359.H0xxEm&t=1&akid=216%2E357359%2EH0xxEm)**
Let us level with you: tomorrow’s official FEC deadline is the most important one of our campaign so far and a big opportunity for our campaign. Here’s why:
1. **The general election has already started:** Our Republican opponents are going to be looking for any signs of weakness. And if we’re able to report a massive number of donations, we can make clear we’re ready to run a general election campaign that can win in November.

2. **We’re not taking a dime of corporate PAC money:** Our campaign is people-powered by folks like you chipping in what you can afford, when you can afford it, and we’ve earned support from every county in North Carolina. We’re incredibly proud of that fact, but it also means small-dollar donations are even more important.

3. **This is going to be an incredibly competitive race:** Cook Political Report has rated North Carolina as a “toss-up,” and CNN said just this month that it’s one of Democrats’ three best chances to pick up a Senate seat. So you know that Republicans are going to do — and spend — anything they can to try to defeat Cheri and stop us from expanding our majority.

**[Please make your first contribution to our campaign. Do it before our official FEC deadline tomorrow night and help us show everyone — including pundits and our Republican opponents — that Cheri has what it takes to win this race.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-dec21?refcode=em211230-3-ma&refcode2=216.357359.H0xxEm&t=2&akid=216%2E357359%2EH0xxEm)**

Thank you!
-Team Cheri Beasley

Raleigh, NC 27611

## 2021 Reflections of Serving the People, Not the System
---
As we quickly head toward transitioning into 2022, I have been deeply reflective of 2021. Of all the many actions I took to answer countless calls to help families and individuals in need, this photo is one of my very favorites from this past year, and what it represents. This may not seem iconic upon initial review, but for Oregon, it was historical.
---
The photo above was taken in June at our in-person eighth-grade graduation ceremony for Alsea School, just days after our in-person high school graduation had also successfully and safely taken place. The ability to have full, in-person learning and graduation ceremonies meant the world to our staff, our students and their families, and to me, personally. I had had a year where I drove several students to our school each day so they could return to the classroom as their own school doors remained closed to full services. What was revealed to me about the significance of that was especially brought forth with our new student Sam, a senior, who had transferred into my district after his parents approached me for help. His story will never leave me and holds a special place in my heart.
---
[](https://u22856175.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=Qqu2eGArjYt8p8lYGOqE7ZaHwBN5Kwqo-2B1YPGFDE2tUta0Ry3rQK03bOWujv4uavH8iWqio4oDrpYizklg-2B1MA-3D-3DdZhG_XwU9lPq5-2Bze3gI64ohlV0cQwWAuBAU7ADIvj2CS7ymhuTI2jG3IYR5NWbV52qgmdAiGhBklNQsRXTWl4rWtz6V26ifmsOhc2lTNkdXy-2F5FFomLfxGZOGa3bZcww1pfz6DRWrl-2BM4rQaWWPTozdJLyMMS-2Bjb6mwmKRGf2Caz4nTYvjzBeKNMD2eshs6qoSD1DyPvIhyE99nlwramO0E9xO4gBXqwu5sPPoHcSFOn-2Bh-2Fp7iwpDiQJc5JVeBveB7qLPorG6WGKmrDczPcuIRC4brHHdmqVmztVdLA2pyDyPS1pwAkUQF8qyLQfyg7D-2Fo8yIg1xh363UTh855uDKF7royrfHK6Ic8uFimbqvv4SnZnCQUe9UoLYlIwFcHkJewqOMtEuYrHLJMonDjPWkYuEEC-2Bw-2Ft3OPAVA3-2Bfm4gWptpp1sZkFJCQU7BSrAY4MFr7pruGuuLjsEAgKgHFAW9XYsGwQFqUlKEpie7p19cp9jNTGxXEOosPG7FRuwLj3GqnLO445x3LeHczKYcqJRkqvVgC-2FI8dnJNnljndzDCcbgl-2BKYqPdCTuQgeRanrDI7-2Bb1LCgjNKUwzN8bJzLb55YvzoGdAok67X4L00mhrCYPq5VuBP5Cwutiyu-2F-2FmU-2FMbTdLUM2b93hIWbgN5fdRo9jeqUHT97lpBx6VnU82qG34U4Yvh1YDMr07shlRV-2FclpJCKpqJUfh8hia5wy2YfzPEVr1-2BQ2NPn0VscApN7v4pJc0cCs7Qu6uUHI-2BJGOWcDoFeHDH6xnS1BGRcareATQUCrV5GrDock9avghL33DleWU3TRFIYmCGKiuQjmspJKDojHUMmNODnwli7b4tS0jjn9wOPDJ25y54jdO62HgsPxCknqwZ6bfo3NrjJXlXSgqSorR6Nzezth-2F2-2FsPJqQcxcSZBWm0wVlP70FopClIQQm9ymA-3D)
---
Standing there with Brenda, my beautiful and supportive wife, as we were watching students sing the national anthem before I headed up to stage where I shared some words, was a snapshot in time that I will never forget. I’m glad this photo was captured so I could share it with all of you, too.
---
I’m proud of the incredible work accomplished as a community to make it a reality, despite outside naysayers that said we would cause harm by staying open. In fact, it would have been quite the opposite. Grave harm happened across communities where schools were closed to full, in-person learning, and families, businesses and children suffered greatly as a result of failed lockdown policies. clean_body: | | | | As we quickly head toward transitioning into 2022, I have been deeply reflective of 2021. 2021 Reflections of Serving the People, Not the System As we quickly head toward transitioning into 2022, I have been deeply reflective of 2021. Of all the many actions I took to answer countless calls to help families and individuals in need, this photo is one of my very favorites from this past year, and what it represents. This may not seem iconic upon initial review, but for Oregon, it was historical. The photo above was taken in June at our in-person eighth-grade graduation ceremony for Alsea School, just days after our in-person high school graduation had also successfully and safely taken place. The ability to have full, in-person learning and graduation ceremonies meant the world to our staff, our students and their families, and to me, personally. I had had a year where I drove several students to our school each day so they could return to the classroom as their own school doors remained closed to full services. What was revealed to me about the significance of that was especially brought forth with our new student Sam, a senior, who had transferred into my district after his parents approached me for help. His story will never leave me and holds a special place in my heart. Standing there with Brenda, my beautiful and supportive wife, as we were watching students sing the national anthem before I headed up to stage where I shared some words, was a snapshot in time that I will never forget. I’m glad this photo was captured so I could share it with all of you, too. I’m proud of the incredible work accomplished as a community to make it a reality, despite outside naysayers that said we would cause harm by staying open. In fact, it would have been quite the opposite. Grave harm happened across communities where schools were closed to full, in-person learning, and families, businesses and children suffered greatly as a result of failed lockdown policies. It breaks my heart to know of such suffering. It adds to my resolve to help renew our state and support all Oregonians! In our state, you may have a special opportunity to deduct $50.00 from the total of Oregon taxes that you pay (or $100 for joint filings), if you donate to a qualifying organization, which can include . Collectively, $50 can quickly become a freedom chest of $50,000, if just 1,000 Oregonians take advantage of this option. We can continue to build up our movement and our momentum by taking advantage of this gift by giving before the end of the year! | If we come together collaboratively, we can create even greater impact to ensure that we help Oregon restore balance, peace and prosperity for all. Let’s end the year with reflections on how we can effectively work together to reclaim our state as we bring back into focus the moments that brought us greater resolve in 2021, for an amazing 2022. I pray that this coming New Year brings even more hope and an honoring of our state and federal constitutions that serve to protect and prosper all Oregonians. Let us not be struck down by elitists and their “rules for thee but not for me” rhetoric; let us rise up against the efforts to divide us as we refuse to give up our God-given freedoms! “I will give them an undivided heart and put a new spirit in them; I will remove from them their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh.”(Ezekiel 11:19). We are each given an opportunity for new beginnings, new mercies and a renewed sense of peace through Him. May we be blessed as we enter into a New Year! Thank you for being part of our next historical moments as we carry this great momentum forward as a movement by the People Oregon, for the People Oregon!
